title: Senior National Account Manager - Industry & Manufacturing
description: The Practical Detail Location: Southwark, London Working Model: Hybrid Why this role matters In your first year, you will lead the commercial growth of Flora Professional's Industry & Manufacturing business across the UK and Ireland, driving sustainable revenue growth and securing new strategic partnerships. This role is vital to expanding Flora's presence in key sectors such as bakery, desserts, soups, sauces, and beverages. By combining commercial expertise with culinary innovation, you will help manufacturers create exceptional food products that meet evolving consumer needs. Your work will directly support Flora Food Group's mission to deliver better food solutions that inspire kitchens and delight consumers. What you'll do Lead the execution of Flora Professional's growth strategy across Industry & Manufacturing sectors, identifying new commercial opportunities. Build and maintain trusted partnerships with procurement, commercial, technical, and culinary stakeholders at leading food manufacturers. Collaborate with Culinary, Marketing, Technical, and R&D teams to develop innovative recipes and product applications that showcase Flora's portfolio. Drive commercial excellence through negotiations, joint business planning, pricing discussions, and long-term agreements. Manage and coach a Junior Key Account Manager, fostering a culture of accountability and high performance. Performance You will own the commercial growth of a key business area generating over 45% gross margin in the UK channel. Your data-driven approach and commercial insight will ensure sustainable revenue growth, improved customer engagement, and operational excellence. Success will be measured by your ability to meet growth targets, secure new partnerships, and maintain strong sales performance. Care This role reports to senior leadership and includes line management of a Junior Key Account Manager. You will work closely across functions including Marketing, Technical, R&D, Culinary, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure aligned and sustainable commercial execution. Your decisions will balance short-term results with long-term partnerships and responsible business practices that build lasting value for Flora and its customers. Passion You are a food lover and innovator who thrives on combining commercial success with culinary creativity. Your curiosity about taste, nutrition, functionality, and reliability drives you to help customers develop exceptional products that stand out in the market. You take pride in contributing to Flora Food Group's future-focused approach to better food, inspiring kitchens and consumers alike. About you You bring proven experience managing strategic B2B accounts within Foodservice, FMCG, or Industry & Manufacturing, with a strong track record of growing long-term commercial opportunities. You understand the complexity of manufacturing customers and excel at building trusted partnerships. Your commercial acumen is demonstrated through leading negotiations, pricing, and joint business planning. You communicate effectively, influence stakeholders, and work cross-functionally with diverse teams. Your entrepreneurial mindset, resilience, and curiosity help you identify new opportunities and challenge the status quo. You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences. Where this could lead to This role typically leads to senior commercial leadership positions within Flora Professional or broader commercial roles across the business. Over time, you can expect to take on greater responsibility for shaping strategy and leading larger teams, influencing Flora Food Group's growth across multiple markets. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.</p> <p><strong>About the Job</strong></p> <p>The Senior Tax Analyst will join a world-class finance operation to support the daily operations of our global tax function, promoting continuous improvement and high performance. In this role, you will complete critical domestic and international tax initiatives required to support dynamic growth and scale. We are seeking an exceptional teammate with a learning and growth mindset who challenges the status quo to improve processes. You will thrive in a fast-paced environment while driving impact through quantitative problem-solving and collaboration.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prepare global direct and indirect tax filings while collaborating with outside service providers on sales, use, business, and digital service taxes across various jurisdictions.</li> <li>Support the preparation of income tax provisions, including standard calculations, tax account roll-forward schedules, and return-to-provision analyses.</li> <li>Develop cross-department tax projections, model income tax scenarios, and conduct strategic research for business initiatives and compliance.</li> <li>Identify key areas of improvement throughout the tax compliance process to develop and execute actionable plans.</li> <li>Prepare monthly General Ledger account reconciliations and communicate required journal entries for direct and indirect tax accounts.</li> <li>Ensure indirect taxes are accurately collected by maintaining global product taxability and exemption certificates, while also supporting tax audits.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience in Public Accounting or an in-house tax department.</li> <li>A Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in tax, accounting, finance, economics, or a related field.</li> <li>Comprehensive understanding of global direct and indirect tax frameworks and regulations.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to produce timely deliverables and manage shifting priorities in a dynamic environment.</li> <li>Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills to coordinate with various internal and external groups.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven track record of identifying process improvements and executing action plans with high attention to detail.</li> <li>Experience researching strategic tax opportunities, risks, and compliance projects.</li> <li>Highly analytical mindset with a strong affinity for quantitative problem-solving and financial modeling.</li> <li>Results-driven approach with a high level of integrity and professional standards.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h4><strong>Benefits and Perks</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year</li> <li>Focus on mental health and well-being:</li> <ul> <li>Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth</li> <li>Company-paid subscription to Headspace</li> <li>Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)</li> </ul> <li>Paid parental leave</li> <li>5 weeks paid vacation</li> <li>Time off for your birthday</li> <li>Paid volunteer time</li> <li>Focus on title: Account Executive, MidMarket (German)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2>What's the opportunity? </h2> <p>As a MidMarket Account Executive, you’ll be at the forefront of growth. You’ll own both sides of your territory: winning new logos and growing a portfolio of existing customers to realize the full power of Fin. We’re building a world-class sales organization that is fast, ambitious and driven, and the road ahead is very exciting.</p> <p>This is a seat at the center of the biggest shift selling has seen in decades. You’ll be selling AI agents to fast-growing businesses rethinking how their entire customer experience works, so the conversations are strategic, technical and interesting. You’ll also use AI every day to run your own territory, from qualification to research to how you run a deal. We’re asking customers to make Fin the heartbeat of their business. That takes salespeople who can think bigger, move faster and win with integrity. We invest deeply in every seller’s growth, and development is built into how we promote, learn and lead. In a high-velocity environment that rewards ownership, creativity and ambition, you’ll find room to stretch, influence and make your mark.</p> <h2>What will I be doing? </h2> <ul> <li>Lead the growth and adoption of Fin across your MidMarket territory, with both new prospects and existing customers</li> <li>Manage the full new business sales cycle, from prospecting to close, through a highly consultative approach</li> <li>Own and grow a portfolio of existing customers, driving expansion, retention, renewals and long-term loyalty</li> <li>Engage key buyer personas to uncover pain points, position AI-driven solutions and tie Fin directly to business impact</li> <li>Build data-backed territory and account plans that target new logos, upsell, cross-sell and multi-business-unit expansion</li> <li>Manage a high volume of deals, including complex six-figure opportunities across new and existing business</li> <li>Articulate Fin’s value and differentiation using Command of the Message and MEDDPICC. If these are new to you, you’ll be trained on them</li> <li>Run your business with discipline through QBRs, territory planning, and weekly and monthly forecasting across new business and renewal pipeline</li> <li>Track and communicate the metrics behind your growth, including retention, adoption and platform expansion</li> <li>Partner with Sales Leaders, Sales Engineers, Customer Success and the wider solutions team to win flagship logos and grow strategic accounts</li> <li>Bring the voice of the customer to R&D, Product and Marketing, turning real customer needs into product innovation and GTM alignment</li> <li>Stay at the cutting edge of AI using the best internal tooling and enablement in the market</li> <li>Raise the bar for the team by mentoring peers and sharing winning plays</li> </ul> <h2>What skills do I need? </h2> <ul> <li>4+ years in a quota-carrying closing role selling SaaS or DBaaS, with a track record of meeting and exceeding quota</li> <li>Business-level fluency in German</li> <li>Experience winning new business and managing a book of existing customers through retention, renewals and expansion. Strong experience in one with a clear appetite for the other is also welcome</li> <li>Experience, passion and success in outbound prospecting</li> <li>Proven success navigating procurement, complex renewals and senior decision makers </li> <li>Experience selling products with technical complexity or thorough implementation</li> <li>AI fluency or a deep interest in AI tooling, with the ability to turn technical capability into customer value</li> <li>Energized by working in a fast-moving, evolving organization across inbound, outbound and existing customer opportunities</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus skills & attributes </h2> <ul> <li>Experience selling AI-powered products</li> <li>Sharp written and verbal communication, adapted to senior stakeholders and technical teams alike</li> <li>A trusted-advisor mindset, building long-term partnerships across multiple levels of complex organizations</li> <li>Demonstrated leadership and influence within your team and across functions</li> <li>A growth mindset, intellectual curiosity and ambition</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p> <p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at<a href="http://fin.ai/careers"> fin.ai/careers</a>. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. </p> <p><strong>Policies </strong></p> <p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p> <p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our <a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.  </p> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal">Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.</a> Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. description: About Zip Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before. The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA. Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups. Your Role We’re looking for a Solutions Architect to help build the technical foundation that powers Zip’s ERP and integration ecosystem. This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the SAP ecosystem. As Zip continues to scale rapidly across enterprise customers like Coinbase, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Snowflake, and Databricks, your impact will be foundational: creating reusable integration assets, defining standards of how the Zip product interacts with external systems. You Will You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams while reporting to Engineering to design, maintain, and iterate on Zip-owned ERP and integration templates that power scalable, repeatable customer implementations. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of future implementations are delivered, raising the technical bar for both our EPD teams and our customer-facing technical consultant organization. Architect & standardize SAP integrations: Design, build, maintain, and iterate on Zip’s core SAP (ECC and S/4HANA) and Ariba integration templates, ensuring they deliver scalable, repeatable, and robust customer implementations. Drive technical implementation excellence: Define, document, and champion technical solution consulting best practices, raising the technical bar and driving consistency across all implementations. Become a Multi-ERP expert: Leverage your existing SAP, P2P, and module expertise (MM/FI) to build deep fluency across additional ERP ecosystems, ultimately becoming the ultimate subject matter expert on integration architecture, data models, and Zip’s App Studio. Ability to translate highly technical information for audiences with varying degrees of technical knowledge. Comfortable working with API documentation. Comfortable testing and troubleshooting integration errors. Able to understand customer requirements and document that information quickly, with little oversight A continual learner and open to learning new technologies that Zip may integrate with in the future. Strong communication skills. Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive. Experience working with product and engineering teams. Process-driven with a strong bias toward continuous improvement; you consistently look for opportunities to make systems better than you found them through systematic improvement. title: VP Data Centres
description: <p><strong>ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD</strong></p> <p>NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.</p> <p>We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.</p> <p><strong>THE ROLE: VP OF DATA CENTRE STRATEGY</strong></p> <p>Everything we sell depends on having the right power, in the right place, at the right time. Until now, decisions about where we build, who we partner with and how we secure capacity have been spread across the business. This new role brings them under one owner: someone who sets NexGen’s global data centre strategy and makes sure capacity is there before customers need it.</p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role, and it covers both strategy and execution. One day you’re taking a site recommendation to the executive team. The next you’re across the table from a colocation operator negotiating a multi-year contract. We plan to build a dedicated development function over time. Until then, you’ll do more of the hands-on delivery work yourself, and you’ll help decide when that team gets built.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING</strong></p> <p>Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:<br>- Build and own NexGen’s global data centre strategy and the 12–36 month capacity roadmap, so capacity is never the reason we miss a customer commitment<br>- Decide which markets and regions we expand into, set the criteria for choosing sites, and build a pipeline of data centre opportunities against them<br>- Make the call on colocation vs. owned infrastructure, and own the investment case for each site<br>- Secure reliable, cost-effective power for GPU-dense workloads, in line with our 100% renewable commitment, and spot grid and capacity constraints before they hit customers<br>- Lead the big negotiations on colocation agreements, power contracts and strategic vendor deals, and hold partners to their SLAs<br>- Set NexGen’s position on data sovereignty and planning across jurisdictions, and deal with regulators and government directly when the stakes are high<br>- Bring cost per MW and cost per GPU rack down, and make sure capex goes where the commercial pipeline needs it</p> <p><strong>ABOUT YOU</strong></p> <p>We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:</p> <p><em>Essential:</em><br>- 10+ years in data centre infrastructure, with significant time in a senior strategy, development or commercial role<br>- A proven track record in site selection, colocation negotiation and data centre partner management at scale<br>- A deep understanding of power procurement and capacity planning, and of the commercial side of running GPU-dense AI infrastructure<br>- Experience negotiating complex, multi-year contracts with data centre operators and vendors<br>- An established network across the colocation ecosystem, plus experience at or with neoclouds, hyperscalers or GPU infrastructure platforms</p> <p><em>Nice to Have:</em><br>- Power procurement for high-density compute specifically, rather than general enterprise space<br>- Grid connection, sovereign cloud or government engagement in more than one jurisdiction<br>- Existing relationships with renewable power providers or experience structuring PPAs<br>- Experience growing an infrastructure function from a standalone role into a team, including deciding when to bring in dedicated delivery capability</p> <p><strong>WHAT WE OFFER</strong></p> <p>- Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme<br>- Employee wellbeing benefits<br>- 25 days holiday, plus public holidays<br>- Private Medical Insurance<br>- Enhanced Pension Scheme<br>- Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)<br>- Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment<br>- Visible, meaningful impact as we scale<br>- Clear career progression in a high-growth company<br>- A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership<br>- The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future</p> <p><strong>WHY APPLY</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we’d like to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>MORE INFORMATION</strong></p> <p>Visit our <a href="https://www.nexgencloud.com/careers">careers page</a> to learn more about us or follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/nexgen-cloud">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://x.com/CloudNexgen">X</a> to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.</p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Director to partner with one of WPP's most strategically important technology platforms.</p> <p>This role will act as the dedicated security leader for WPP Open — our AI-powered marketing and business operating platform — helping ensure that security, trust, resilience and client assurance are embedded into how the platform evolves and scales.</p> <p>Working at the intersection of platform security, product security, AI risk and client trust, you'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, AI and operational teams to shape security outcomes across a high-growth, highly innovative environment.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to influence how one of WPP's most important technology investments manages security at scale while enabling innovation and business growth.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What you'll be doing:</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Security Leadership & Business Partnering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary security partner for <li>Champion security as an enabler of innovation rather than a barrier to delivery.</li> <li>Represent WPP Open within broader security governance and leadership forums.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Product & AI Security</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with product and engineering teams to strengthen secure software development practices.</li> <li>Support the ongoing evolution of platform, application and API security controls.</li> <li>Help shape the governance and assurance of AI-enabled capabilities and agentic workflows.</li> <li>Drive a risk-based approach to emerging challenges including AI misuse, prompt abuse and data protection.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client Trust & Security Assurance:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help ensure robust controls around client data protection, segregation and confidentiality.</li> <li>Support client assurance activities and security commitments for some of the world's leading brands.</li> <li>Partner with internal stakeholders to maintain trust and confidence in WPP Open's security posture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Identity, Resilience & Risk:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the evolution of modern identity and access security models across the platform.</li> <li>Contribute to platform resilience, continuity planning and recovery readiness.</li> <li>Work closely with cyber incident response teams on security events, investigations and risk management activities.</li> <li>Help define and communicate security metrics, risk indicators and platform security trends to senior stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What you'll need:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience in cyber security, product security, platform security or business-aligned security leadership roles.</li> <li>Experience partnering with engineering, product and business teams in fast-moving technology environments.</li> <li>Strong understanding of security challenges associated with cloud-native platforms, SaaS products and modern software delivery.</li> <li>Knowledge of areas such as AI security, identity and access management, API security, client data protection and platform resilience.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills.</li> <li>A pragmatic approach, balancing security requirements with product innovation and business objectives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience securing AI-enabled products, platforms or digital services.</li> <li>Familiarity with recognised security frameworks such as ISO 27001, ISO 42001, SOC2, NIST AI RMF or OWASP AI Top 10.</li> <li>Experience working with cloud environments including Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.</li> <li>Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP or equivalent.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who you are:</strong></span></p> <p><strong>You're open<em>:</em> </strong>We are inclusive and We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.</p> <p><strong>You're optimistic<em>:</em></strong> <span id="628d56ad5d8a35dab853e65d9daa237c" class="editor-module-hl-green-solid">We believe</span> in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.</p> <p><strong>You're extraordinary:</strong> we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.</p> <p> </p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What we'll give you:</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Passionate, inspired people</strong> – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.</p> <p><strong>Scale and opportunity</strong> – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.</p> <p><strong>Challenging and stimulating work</strong> – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. title: Demo Software Engineer (f/m/d)
description: <h2>About The Opportunity</h2> <p>As a <strong>Demo</strong> <strong>Software Engineer (f/m/d)  </strong>you will be responsible for developing digital applications showcasing the use of Contentful within well-established categories and emerging areas. You will be the first to see new product features and play a critical role in bringing them to the market by building demos featured in product launches, analyst calls and annual customer conferences. In the off-season, you will help Contentful users get the most out of the product by developing how-to guides and tutorials, recording technical videos, and - occasionally - conducting in-person workshops.</p> <p>This is a hands-on position that requires solid development skills and experience in shipping successful digital applications. You will be routinely asked to create things from scratch and craft delightful interaction loops, so creative thinking and good UX instincts are important for this role. Expect to be working on a wide range of tasks - frontend, backend, QA, devops - and a diverse set of projects spanning web, mobile, internal tooling, and AI. The demo team operates a modern technology stack and has a lot of say in deciding what tools and architectural patterns to use on the job.  </p> <p>While the core Demo team is small, we work with numerous stakeholders to deliver on our goals. We partner with Sales, Product, Engineering and Partnership teams to identify key business requirements and technical specifications for demo assets. We are experienced at augmenting our team with freelancers, agencies, and partners when tackling large-scale development projects. And we work closely with other marketing teams to drive product adoption through long-term educational programs and ad hoc campaigns.</p> <h2>What To Expect?</h2> <p>Be a part of an agile development team with a high impact across the organization: </p> <ul> <li>Support popular customer use cases and enable integrations with leading cloud providers, AI services and SaaS vendors</li> <li>Identify high-value technical problems and prototype quick solutions in the form of components, apps, integrations or full-fledged demo environments to address them.</li> <li>Master technical topics underpinning effective use of the Contentful platform, including content modeling, design systems, content orchestration, composable architectures, etc</li> <li>Develop expertise in using the customer-facing Contentful platform (e.g. APIs, CLI, webhooks, Forma36 design system, App framework, etc.) and internal systems (e.g. monitoring, deployment, AI-assisted development work)</li> <li>Effectively leverage devops infrastructure and AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, conduct effective QA, and support end-to-end workflows for internal users</li> <li>Prototype new integrations with our tech partners (among them OpenAI, Vercel, Algolia, Commercetools, Bynder, Ninetailed, Slack)</li> <li>Collaborate with Sales Engineering, Developer Relations, Solutions Architecture, and Product Marketing to create polished demo sites and apps</li> <li>Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Design to implement new features in demo environments and provide effective product feedback</li> <li>Coach junior engineers and peers, act as a tech lead for cross-functional projects  and projects delivered by external contractors</li> </ul> <h2>What You Need To Be Successful</h2> <ul> <li>6+ years of software development experience and/or systems engineering experience</li> <li>Strong technical experience with JavaScript, TypeScript and React</li> <li>Solid understanding of modern frontend frameworks (React/Vue/Svelte)</li> <li>Extensive experience working with APIs (including GraphQL API)</li> <li>Understanding of CI/CD workflows and devops best practices</li> <li>Ability to identify and prioritize high-impact problems and independently deliver solutions that provide reasonable effort/quality trade-offs </li> <li>Innate curiosity and ability to empathize with end users</li> <li>Good communication skills and ability to present complex technical concepts in an accessible way</li> <li>Proactive attitude and ability to master new topics quickly (there is a lot to learn on the job)</li> <li>Experience in full-stack development, working with AI, implementing design systems in production, launching mobile apps, and leading product development workshops is a plus</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: left;">More details about our company benefits can be found at the following link: <a class="link__new-tab" href="https://www.salesforcebenefits.com/" target="_blank">https://www.salesforcebenefits.com</a>.</p> <h6> </h6><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Contentful is now officially part of Salesforce.</strong></p> <h2>Unleash Your Potential</h2> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. title: Manager, Revenue Strategy & Operations, UK
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact Own the commercial strategy and revenue operations backbone for Airwallex’s fast-growing UK & Ireland business, helping the region deliver against its growth ambition while building the foundations for sustainable growth. Drive high-impact, cross-functional priorities from strategy through execution, turning them into practical systems and operating rhythms. Partner with commercial leadership as a local strategic advisor, providing performance and forecasting support, running country QBRs and driving improvements across the business. Build the operational infrastructure for the UK & Ireland commercial teams, including territory development and management, AI tooling and insight-led performance tracking. Improve commercial workflows and reporting by applying AI-driven tools and automation. Align Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product, Engineering, Compliance and Legal around regional priorities, connecting local needs with global teams and helping the business make better decisions faster. You'll work from our London office three days a week. What we're looking for Essentials 3–5 years of work experience, ideally with a mix of top-tier strategy consulting and/or high-growth startup experience, including meaningful time focused on commercial strategy or revenue operations. Strong analytical skills, including data modelling and experience working with data reporting tools. Experience owning processes end to end, building scalable systems and tooling, and maintaining high standards of data quality and hygiene. Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority. Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills. A track record of taking ownership, driving tangible outcomes and getting things done in ambiguous environments. An outstanding record of academic achievement. Preferred Experience in a high-growth fintech, financial services or technology environment. Experience with complex, cross-functional commercial operations and scaling go-to-market processes. Experience using AI-driven tools and automation to streamline commercial workflows and reporting. You'll thrive here if You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway. You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details. You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it. You're low-ego. You care more about the right outcome than getting credit for it. You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work. You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office three days a week. You've worked in a high-growth or scaling environment and know what it takes to build systems that need to grow with the business. You have experience at a fintech, payments company, or other highly regulated business. Learn more about your team Most strategy roles hand you a slide deck. This one hands you the keys. Strategy & Operations finds the next point of leverage in a hyper-growth fintech, then builds the system to capture it. We spot opportunities early, design how Airwallex scales into them, and turn that vision into the machinery that drives revenue across markets and products. You'll get the kind of access most people wait a decade for: a direct line to the growth engine, work that spans every function, and the freedom to own ambiguous, high-stakes problems end to end. And you won't do it the old way. We arm our people with AI to move faster than teams ten times our size, modeling, researching, and shipping at a pace that creates an unfair advantage. If you want to do the best work of your career on problems that actually matter, build with us. As Airwallex scales into new markets and deepens its engagement with global regulatory bodies, we are building a world-class compliance organization capable of managing complex financial crime risks at scale. Proven experience designing enterprise-wide risk assessment frameworks and maintaining highly centralized global policies with localized regional addenda. Demonstrated experience preparing risk papers and leading the defense during high-stakes regulatory examinations and internal or external audits. A high-ownership, pragmatic approach, with excellent written communication and stakeholder management skills to influence cross-functional executives and board audiences. Advanced professional designations such as CAMS-Audit, CGSS (Certified Global Sanctions Specialist), or CAMS-RM (Risk Management). Deep fintech and payments experience, including a strong understanding of cross-border payment mechanisms, virtual accounts, multi-currency wallets, or multi-entity regulated groups. Experience partnering directly with Product, Data Science, and Engineering teams to hardcode policy thresholds into automated transaction monitoring, screening, and onboarding workflows. What you'll be doing Work the IAM, IT and Workplace Tech queue alongside the team, and set the bar for turnaround and quality. Work with Security and GRC on access reviews, least privilege and evidence for PCI DSS and SOC 2. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.</span></p></div><h2><strong>The work:</strong></h2> <p>We're seeking a dedicated, passionate, and eager Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to join our team responsible for leading large cross-functional programs linked to our Products. This role reports to the Head of TPM within Ripple Core. This is a challenging and technical role, requiring the expertise to synthesize business and technical requirements and the foresight to ensure we are solving for Ripple's current and future customer needs. You will bring a strong understanding of traditional finance and trading markets, and use it to help bridge the needs of financial institutions with the capabilities of digital asset infrastructure. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams to design robust and scalable systems, lead product schedules, remove roadblocks, and ensure high development velocity. Ideal candidates have a track record of owning complex, multi-team programs end to end and providing technical leadership to deliver for customers. You will shape program strategy and execution within your area, while knowing when to get hands-on to push an initiative forward. You must be passionate about enabling teams to invent and deliver customer-focused solutions to bold and ambiguous challenges.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the strategy, planning, and execution of one or more complex, cross-functional programs across our product initiatives by understanding our customers, markets, and technology deeply.</li> <li>Reduce ambiguity and risk by proactively identifying and eliminating bottlenecks and obstacles, raising issues strategically, and making sound data-driven decisions that deliver for our customers based on associated trade-offs.</li> <li>Communicate with purpose and clarity to stakeholders at all levels, including executive leadership, bringing together cross-functional teams to achieve program objectives.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Engineering, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Operations to ensure programs meet the regulatory, operational, and control expectations of institutional clients.</li> <li>Mentor and support other TPMs, and contribute to raising the bar for program management practices across the organization.</li> <li>Contribute to technical and operational frameworks that engineering teams can use for decision-making and Operational Excellence.</li> <li>Partner with program managers, product managers, and engineering managers to understand development priorities and drive alignment across multiple partners with impactful priorities.</li> <li>Lead large, strategic cross-company initiatives end-to-end, from shaping scope and success metrics with leadership through launch, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.</li> <li>Own the full program lifecycle across Product, Engineering, and go-to-market teams, driving alignment on priorities, managing dependencies and risks, and holding teams accountable to commitments.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>10+ years of technical program management experience leading complex, cross-functional programs in sophisticated enterprise technology environments, working directly with many teams across functions.</li> <li>Experience managing programs in traditional finance (TradFi), such as banking, asset management, broker-dealers, custodians, or financial market infrastructure, with a solid understanding of the financial services landscape.</li> <li>Experience with and understanding of trading markets (crypto or traditional), including the trade lifecycle (order management, execution, clearing, and settlement), market structure, and liquidity.</li> <li>Ability to use data and analytics to look at trends and lead the health of projects and systems.</li> <li>Shown understanding and working knowledge of software development and modern project management standard title: Partner Operations Manager
description: Location: Our offices are in Central London, along with several of our customers. Travel to our customer sites is required, the frequency of which will vary from customer-to-customer. You need to be able to travel onsite to London up to 3 days per week, although onsite requirements will vary week-to-week and customer-to-customer from 0 to 3 days. Salary: £30,000-£40,000 SC Clearance Requirements: Due to working with several government bodies, SC clearance is required for all our customer facing teams. You do not need active SC clearance as we will undertake checks upon you joining, but you must be eligible to pass SC clearance . In future, DV clearance may be required, so the ability/willingness to pass DV clearance is advantageous but not essential. You must be UK-based . About us We help major public and private sector organisations scale cloud and AI with speed, control and clarity. Hard-won experience sits behind a values-led business that does the right thing, puts customers first and builds partnerships on trust rather than lock-in. Our work is practical. We design secure, production-ready foundations that hold up in the real world and deliver lasting value, without the waste that slows most transformations down. And we don't advise from the sidelines. We build, fix and deliver ourselves, with no offshoring, no resource-padding and no compromises. What you'll do Cloudscaler works closely with three of the companies shaping cloud and AI right now: AWS, Anthropic and OpenAI. Those partnerships open real doors for us and our customers. Funding for customer programmes. Early access to new models and services. Joint go-to-market. But they only pay off when someone runs them properly. That's this role. You'll own the operational side of our partner programmes. Your goals are clear: help us win partner funding for our customers, achieve new AWS competencies and programme designations, and keep our partner CRMs in excellent shape. The partner managers at AWS, Anthropic and OpenAI will know you by name. This isn't a back-office admin job. AI partner programmes change quarter to quarter, and we want someone who'll build smarter ways of running them. If you've ever automated a tedious task because you couldn't face doing it by hand a second time, you'll fit right in. External responsibilities These responsibilities are partner-facing and customer-facing: Competencies and programme designations - Driving our AWS competency and programme applications, and tracking tier requirements, certifications and renewals across AWS, Anthropic and OpenAI so that nothing lapses. Partner funding applications - Preparing, submitting and tracking partner funding applications (for example the AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) and proof-of-concept funding), working with our sales and delivery teams to gather what each one needs. Funding claims - Managing funding claims through to payment, keeping milestones, evidence and deadlines in order. Partner relationships - Acting as the main operational contact for our partner teams, building strong working relationships with each company. Joint campaigns and events - Helping plan and run joint marketing campaigns with our partners, and representing Cloudscaler at partner events across the UK. Internal responsibilities These responsibilities cover the systems, reporting and ways of working behind our partner programmes. Partner CRMs - Owning our partner CRMs, keeping deal registrations, opportunity data and partner portals accurate across HubSpot and AWS Partner Central. Reporting - Reporting on partner performance, funding pipeline and programme health to the leadership team. Automation - Finding the repetitive work and automating it, using AI tools such as Claude to build workflows, trackers and agents that give the team time back. Briefing colleagues - Briefing colleagues when programmes change, and explaining what it means for our customers and bids. What we're looking for This is an operational role with plenty of partner contact. We expect candidates to demonstrate the following: Operational experience - Experience in partner operations, alliance management, programme management or a similar operational role, ideally in tech or professional services. Attention to detail - A sharp eye for detail. You notice when a date, a figure or a requirement doesn't add up, and you fix it before it costs anyone. Communication - Clear, confident communication in writing and in person, with colleagues, partners and senior stakeholders. Organisation - Strong organisation across many moving parts and competing deadlines. Systems - Comfort with CRM systems (HubSpot ideally) and spreadsheets. Curiosity about AI - Genuine curiosity about AI. You already use tools like Claude or ChatGPT to work faster, and you want to go further. Partner programme knowledge - Experience with AWS partner programmes or cloud funding is a real advantage, but not essential. We'll teach you the specifics. Why this role We hire people who are curious and like to tinker. The people who thrive in this role will be the ones who see a messy process and can't resist building something better, then can explain it to the rest of the team with real enthusiasm. You'll work directly with three of the companies shaping cloud and AI, and as the partner programmes grow, so will the role, with real room to develop your career here. Benefits Periodic offer of share options schemes Discretionary bonus scheme 25 days’ annual leave + 5 additional days for training/exams or volunteering Travel and accommodation expensed where eligible in line with our expenses policy Life Assurance Long Term Disability cover Employee Assist Programme for employee advice and support (including legal and counselling helpline) Health, Mental Health, Wellbeing, Financial and Legal support 24/7 GP access Public holiday opt-out scheme giving you the option to work on public holidays creating the flexibility to enjoy your time off when it suits you Individual training and development plans with online training and exam costs covered Recruitment referral scheme – referral bonus if you introduce us to someone we then hire Customer referral scheme – referral bonus if you introduce us to a new customer Cycle To Work Scheme Dog friendly office Cloudscaler are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to equal opportunities regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ancestry, age, marital status, disability, parental status, religion or medical history. If you require reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process or within the workplace, please let us know when you speak to our Talent Acquisition team or contact Compensation: £30K – £40K • £30K – £40K Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Revenue Operations Manager  - London
description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About the Role: Perk is going through a period of significant growth, and we're using AI and automation to make our sales teams more productive and to take manual work out of our reps' day-to-day, in our tools and in the CRM. Nowhere is that more visible than in our SDR organisation, where we are rolling out AI-driven outbound prospecting with tools like Clay. We're hiring a Revenue Operations Manager in Barcelona to support our SDR organisation globally. This is a senior individual contributor role: a strategic business partner to SDR leadership on process, systems, and operating cadences, and the business owner of the SDR tech stack, from Sales Engagement tooling to LinkedIn Sales Navigator and enrichment. You'll own how SDRs prospect, engage, and hand off pipeline, from the data and signals that tell them who to contact, to the sequences and automations that help them do it at scale, to the reporting that shows what is working. We're looking for a true owner who understands what good looks like, has rolled out AI and automation for outbound at scale elsewhere, and is curious about where AI can take outbound next. What You'll Do: Be the strategic partner to SDR leadership Partner with global SDR leaders to define and run the operating model: processes, territories and handoffs, and the weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadences that keep the team on track. Work with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Sales Enablement, and Finance to keep lead management and pipeline definitions aligned end to end. Own the SDR process Own the end-to-end SDR process, from prospecting and outreach to qualification and handoff to Account Executives, and keep it documented in clear playbooks that are consistent across regions. Own the prospecting process: ICP and account prioritisation, signal-based targeting, and outbound cadences. Own the qualification methodology: lead and opportunity definitions, qualification criteria, stage and disqualification logic, and acceptance standards for handoffs, and evolve them as our go-to-market changes. Own the inbound lead process: capture, routing, speed-to-lead standards, follow-up expectations, ownership rules, and the handoff between Marketing and SDRs. Roll out process changes with SDR leaders and Enablement, and make sure they are adopted and followed. Own the Rules of Engagement for outbound and inbound, including account ownership between regional and global accounts, so SDRs, Account Executives, and Marketing know who works which accounts and leads, and conflicts are resolved quickly and fairly. Own the SDR tech stack Act as the business owner of every tool our SDR organisation uses in its prospecting efforts globally, including Sales Engagement platforms, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and data enrichment tools, owning the roadmap, configuration, licences and cost, adoption, data quality, and vendor relationships. Make sure the tools, the CRM, and the data around them work as one system, so reps spend their time selling, not updating records. Evaluate, pilot, and roll out new tools and features, with clear business cases and success metrics. Partner closely with the Revenue Systems team, who are the technical owners of these tools and manage configuration, syncs, and integrations, by setting priorities and requirements as the business owner, and with Enablement on training and change management. Drive AI and automation for outbound and inbound Partner with the GTM Engineering team, who own Clay and the AI automation for SDRs, and act as the business owner of the SDR automation roadmap, defining the use cases and priorities for AI-driven outbound: signal-based targeting, account and contact research, enrichment, personalisation, and sequencing. Reduce manual work for SDRs by automating CRM updates, lead and account research, routing, and follow-up, and measure the time saved and the pipeline impact. Design and refine lead routing, scoring, and inbound handling so the right leads reach the right reps quickly. Test and pilot emerging AI capabilities for SDR and inbound use cases, and scale what works with clear guardrails on data quality, compliance, and brand. Protect data and quality Set the standards for data hygiene, outreach governance, and deliverability across SDR tools, and make sure they are followed. Build the dashboards and reporting that give SDR leaders and reps a single source of truth on activity, funnel, and outcomes. Document processes and playbooks so they are repeatable across regions. What We're Looking For: Significant experience (typically 5+ years) in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or SDR/Pipeline Operations in B2B SaaS, with a focus on SDR or outbound productivity. Proven experience supporting the roll out of AI and automation for outbound prospecting from a process point of view Deep hands-on knowledge of Salesforce and of Sales Engagement platforms (such as Outreach, Salesloft, or Gong), including sequencing, enrichment, routing, and scoring. Strong analytical skills: you can find the story in funnel and rep-activity data and turn it into decisions that SDR leaders act on. A true owner: you take responsibility for a tool, a process, or an outcome end to end, and you don't wait to be asked. Credibility as a strategic partner to senior sales leaders, comfortable challenging and influencing across Sales, Marketing, Enablement, Finance, and Systems. Strong project and change management skills, with a track record of driving adoption across global teams. Curiosity about AI and where it can take SDR, outbound, and inbound operations next. Comfortable in a fast-growing, fast-changing environment where processes are still being built. What we offer: Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support Hiring Process 30 min online call with Talent Acquisition Online 45min call with the hiring manager IRL Assessment with the Hiring manager + another senior person from the Rev Ops team 30 min online panel interview with the SDR Manager 30 min Online Culture interview with SE Manager AI at Perk AI is embedded in how we work across every function. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes. How We Work At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. title: Senior Manager, Customer Support, Deliveroo Operations
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders to bring the neighbourhood to their door. We're redefining convenience by giving customers the ability to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it. Deliveroo is a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the world's most dynamic industries. We are a relatively small team making a very large impact, moving fast, valuing ownership, and tackling some of the most interesting challenges in global commerce. We're driven by innovation, autonomy, and the ambition to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers, partners, and riders alike. What You'll Be Doing You will own frontline operational performance across two closely linked parts of Deliveroo's customer support network: an in-house Global Escalations team of around 50 agents based across the UK and Georgia, and the outsourced network delivering support on our behalf through three BPO partners and three Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents across multiple locations, including the team leads and ops managers embedded within those outsourced functions. Global Escalations sits at the heart of Deliveroo's most critical customer moments. title: Technical Writer, Frontier AI Best Practice
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About the AI Security Institute</h2> <p>The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.</p> <p>We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.</p></div><div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <h2 class="vac_display_field"><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">The deadline for applying to this role is Sunday 29th November 2026, end of day, anywhere on Earth.</span></span></strong></h2> <h2><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">About the team</span></span></strong></h2> <p>AISI's Technical Standards and Best Practice team identifies what best practice is needed to manage the most serious risks from frontier AI development and leverages AISI’s position to get it adopted. </p> <p>AI capabilities are advancing faster than the science and practices used to manage their risks. Risks now emerge earlier, during training, internal deployment and evaluation, not just at public release, and evaluation methods are struggling to keep pace. Yet there is no consensus on the set of practices needed to safely use and develop the most capable AI systems, and high-level principles are not enough to manage these risks. What's needed is concrete technical guidance that developers agree is necessary. </p> <p>AISI is uniquely placed to lead on parts of this industry-wide effort to establish best practice. We house researchers with state-of-the-art technical insight on keeping AI secure during internal use, hold existing relationships with industry and other frontier AI organisations, and offer a neutral third-party home to establish best practice collaboratively. This role directly delivers on part of the Prime Minister’s September 2026<strong> </strong>commitment that the UK will work towards principles and standards that ensure the most capable AI systems are developed securely and with appropriate transparency. It builds <span data-contrast="auto">directly on our October 2026 publication </span><a href="https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/towards-technical-best-practice-for-frontier-ai-development"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">Towards technical best practice for frontier AI development</span></span></a><span data-contrast="auto">, setting out our view of the most urgent priorities.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":60,"335559739":120,"335559740":259}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">This is a new, growing team with high ambitions. It is a cross AISI initiative that draws on and collaborates with researchers and engineers from across AISI's research teams, as well as our Communications, International and Strategy teams. We're now building a dedicated core team and expect it to grow as the work does.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559738":60,"335559739":120,"335559740":259}"> </span></p> <h3><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559738":60,"335559739":120,"335559740":259}"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Why this team matters:</span><br></span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">AISI is uniquely placed to shape this guidance, and this team is how we'll do it:</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559738":60,"335559739":120,"335559740":259}"> </span></p> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="61" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="auto">Technical expertise:</span><span data-contrast="auto"> AISI has roughly 10 technical and research teams whose expertise can be drawn on; one of the largest groups working on AI risk outside the frontier AI companies. AISI has evaluated more than 55 frontier models before release and published research on topics such as safety cases, monitorability and control.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":60,"335559740":259}"> </span></li> </ul> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="61" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="2" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="auto">A research institute within government:</span><span data-contrast="auto"> we work directly with leading AI developers, </span><a href="https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2026/07/uk-aisi-caisi-preliminary-assessment-kimi-k3s-cyber-capabilities"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">other governments</span></span></a><span data-contrast="auto">, and third-party evaluators, and can bring them together around practices no single company would set on its own. UK AISI also coordinates the International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science – a group of 10 AI security institutes and equivalents – which has already published its own and socialised others’ best practices. </span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":60,"335559740":259}"> </span></li> </ul> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="61" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="3" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="auto">A track record of shaping industry practice:</span><span data-contrast="auto"> AISI has already helped establish voluntary practices such as pre-release testing, and built Inspect, now the standard framework for leading third-party evaluators.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":60,"335559740":259}"> </span></li> </ul> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We're not seeking to mandate requirements. We want to contribute our expertise to an industry-wide effort to develop technical best practice that could later inform formal standards.</span><span
