title: Associate Director, Influence - Burson
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a> </p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p>Burson is building three global Influence & Social Centres of Excellence in the US, Singapore, and London. As part of our UK Centre of Excellence, which serves as the hub for the EMEA region, we are seeking an Associate Director, Influence to play a pivotal, hands-on role in scaling and evolving our Total Influence offer.</p> <p>This is an exciting opportunity for a mid-to-senior influencer specialist who combines strategic vision with flawless operational execution. Sitting within our multi-disciplinary capability, you will be the day-to-day strategic engine and trusted advisor across all agency practices. You will plan, oversee, and execute best-in-class influencer-led campaigns that earn cultural relevance, protect reputation, and deliver measurable business impact.</p> <p>As an Influence Associate Director, you will be a dynamic, commercially astute specialist and creative thinker, leading best-in-class, influencer-led content strategies and programmes across all agency sectors. Viewing "influence" holistically, you will provide strategic and practical counsel to clients and internal teams; from identification, vetting, and contracting to creative co-creation, paid integration, and measurement. Partnering with UK head of Influence, you will elevate Burson’s influencer marketing offer, inspire dedicated specialists, and upskill teams to deliver exceptional, measurable results.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p></p> <div> <h3>Grow: Commercial & Sector Partnership</h3> <ul> <li>Strategic Influence Partner: Act as a trusted adviser to sector and practice leads, translating client and business briefs into culturally relevant, influencer-led strategies.</li> <li>Commercial & Organic Growth: Partner with the UK Head of Influence and senior teams to develop winning pitches, shape commercial models and identify opportunities to grow influence across existing and new client accounts.</li> <li>Holistic Influence Strategy: Champion a broader view of influence beyond traditional creators, incorporating thought leaders, B2B voices, subject-matter experts and advocates across owned, earned, shared and paid channels.</li> </ul> <h3>Enable: Delivery, Operations & Best Practice</h3> <ul> <li>Best-in-Class Campaign Delivery: Lead end-to-end influencer programmes, from discovery, vetting and contracting through to creator briefing, co-creation, rights management and live campaign delivery.</li> <li>Creative, Paid & Performance Integration: Work closely with creators to deliver authentic, high-quality content while connecting organic influence with paid amplification, licensing, whitelisting and performance marketing opportunities.</li> <li>Governance, Tools & Team Development: Ensure programmes meet ASA, CMA, IP and Burson compliance standards, while embedding tools such as CreatorIQ and GWI and upskilling teams on influencer best practice, cultural trends and effective ways of working.</li> </ul> <h3>Transform: Innovation & Modern Measurement</h3> <ul> <li>Measurement & Impact: Partner with data and intelligence specialists to evolve how influence is measured, moving beyond vanity metrics to demonstrate sentiment, cultural share of voice, reputation shift and conversion.</li> <li>Platform & Innovation Leadership: Build strong relationships with platforms including TikTok, Meta, YouTube and LinkedIn, while testing and embedding AI and emerging capabilities through Burson's AI suite and WPP Open to improve discovery, reporting and workflow efficiency.</li> </ul> </div> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven Agency Experience: Substantial influencer marketing experience within an agency, PR, or integrated creative environment, operating at Account Director / Junior Associate Director level.</li> <li>Strategic & Creative Rigour: Ability to plan multi-channel content strategies that are influencer-first, with a strong understanding of how audience mapping and data inform creative platforms and creator selection.</li> <li>Negotiation & Contracting Mastery: Deep practical expertise in creator negotiation, complex scope structuring, multi-platform licensing, exclusivity, and contract management.</li> <li>Tech Fluency: Hands-on proficiency with dedicated influencer tech platforms (specifically CreatorIQ) and consumer research tools (such as GWI).</li> <li>Collaborative Leadership: A natural relationship-builder who can seamlessly partner with cross-functional teams (strategy, creative, earned media, paid, data) and mentor junior talent.</li> <li>Client Advisory Skills: Calm, authoritative client-handling skills with the ability to articulate the strategic value of influencer marketing to both senior brand marketers and communications directors.</li> <li>Commercial Acumen: Experience building accurate scopes of work, production budgets, talent fees, and pitch responses that protect agency margins and client ROI.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Burson UK was named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026!</strong></p> <p><strong>#LI-CY1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our  <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it. </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Research Machine Learning Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About us</h2> <div><strong>Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence<br></strong><br>PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace & defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy & renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.</div></div><h1><span style="font-size: 18pt;">What you'll do</span></h1> <ul> <li>Work closely with our simulation engineers and research scientists to develop an understanding of the physics and engineering challenges we are solving</li> <li>Work at the intersection of data science and software engineering to transform prototype implementations to robust production-grade model implementations, libraries and tooling</li> <li>Work with multi-GPU/multi-node distributed systems for training and inference at the scale of PBs of data and hundreds of GPUs</li> <li>Optimize the models and pipelines on all levels, from job scheduling down to GPU kernels</li> <li>Design and build scalable and robust infrastructure for end-to-end machine learning applications on cloud (CoreWeave, AWS)</li> <li>Continuously apply and improve engineering best practices and standards, coach your colleagues in their adoption.</li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 18pt;">What you'll bring</span></h1> <ul> <li>Enthusiasm about using machine learning for science and engineering, and especially in scaling such solutions to real-world settings</li> <li>Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment, learn and adapt quickly, scope, plan and deliver effectively</li> <li>Strong collaboration and communication skills, especially with research scientists</li> <li>Experience with software engineering concepts and best practices (e.g., versioning, testing, CI/CD, API design, MLOps)</li> <li>Experience building ML models and pipelines in Python, using common libraries and frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX)</li> <li>Experience with the GPU programming ecosystem, ability to optimise models on all levels of the stack, going down to the level of CUDA/Triton/Warp kernels when necessary</li> <li>Experience training and serving ML models at scale</li> <li>Experience with large-scale data processing</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 14pt;">Nice to have</span></h2> <ul> <li>Domain knowledge in physics and/or numerical methods, especially CFD</li> <li>Experience working in the domain of ML for science or engineering</li> <li>Experience building infrastructure on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, CoreWeave)</li> <li>Experience with C/C++, especially for computer vision, geometry processing and scientific computing</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>What we offer</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Build what actually matters</strong></p> <p>Help shape an AI-native engineering company at a formative stage, tackling problems that genuinely matter for industry and society. This is work with real-world impact - and something you can be proud to stand behind.</p> <p><strong>Learn alongside exceptional people</strong></p> <p>Work with a high-caliber, collaborative team of engineers, scientists, and operators who care deeply about doing great work, and about helping each other get better. We come from diverse backgrounds, but we share a commitment to operating at the highest level and addressing some of the most complex challenges out there. If you’re ambitious, thoughtful, and driven by impact, you’ll feel at home.</p> <p><strong>Influence over hierarchy</strong></p> <p>We operate with a flat structure: good ideas win - wherever they come from. Questioning assumptions and challenging the status quo isn’t just welcomed, it’s expected.</p> <p><strong>Sustainable pace, long-term ambition</strong></p> <p>Building meaningful technology is a marathon, not a sprint. We believe in balancing focused, ambitious work with a life beyond it. title: Senior Pricing Analyst, B2B
description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years. Most delivery companies sell on price and volume, and find out later whether a client made them money. Sales teams are measured on what they sign, not on what a signing is worth. Relay wants every client, and every new shop in the network, to be one we'd choose again. That is harder for us than for most, because what a client is worth depends on how their parcels flow through a network that's still growing. Engineering and analytics engineering build what you design. Sales Highlights You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what a client or shop is worth and which signings sales should chase. The sales lead acts on your calls. What is a new client or a new shop worth, when its value depends on where it sits in a network that changes every month? What would you build so sales knows before it signs? Which signings become partners who do well with us, and what does that tell sales to look for? The quarter's target is set. What has to close by when for it to hold, and what would tell you early that it won't? A whole area, not a slice: you decide how sales values what it wins, and the result shows in what we sign next. Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science. The Opportunity As a Senior Pricing Analyst, B2B at Relay, you'll: Decide which Sales problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix. Design how Sales decides: which signals count, what a client or shop is worth, and what good looks like. Tell the sales lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision. Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools. Go and look when the numbers and the street disagree: a new shop, a client's parcels at the sort centre. Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, sales chooses what to go after on measures you built, and can see whether the quarter will land before it ends. We're looking for candidates who… Have owned B2B pricing or commercial decisions and their number, rather than maintaining sales dashboards. Have built, hands on, the first version of how a company values a customer or a deal: unit economics, lifetime value, or what it costs to win one. Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or sales went after different deals because of it. Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes. Can say early whether a quarter will land, and what would tell you it won't. Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast. Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you. Who Thrives at Relay? Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously. Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction. 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience. All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. About us At Legora, we’re changing how lawyers work. Our AI-native platform helps legal teams research, review, draft, and collaborate. We build closely with our clients and ship quickly across a growing number of markets. The role We’re hiring a Product Operations Manager to join our team and be part of the machine that facilitates product release management for the whole company and our clients. You’ll own the operating system around releases for a specific product area: what is shipping, when it is ready, who needs to act, and what happens after launch. You’ll also improve how customer feedback and product data reach Product teams, so decisions are based on useful evidence rather than scattered requests. You’ll need to be exceptionally comfortable with ambiguity and bring a practical, problem-solving mindset. You’ll jump into unfamiliar challenges, learn fast, and turn unclear problems into concrete next steps without waiting for a perfect brief or a ready-made playbook. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role reporting to the Head of Product Operations. You’ll work across Product, Engineering, Support, Product Marketing, Engagement, and customer-facing teams in the US and Europe. What you’ll do Run release planning and readiness for major launches. Keep scope, owners, dependencies, risks, documentation, communications, and rollout decisions clear. Maintain the company-facing view of the product roadmap and releases, and make sure partner teams have accurate information as plans change. Build and maintain a reliable product-feedback process. Turn requests, support issues, and customer observations into evidence Product teams can prioritise and act on. Track product and release health after launch. Use adoption data, operational metrics, and qualitative feedback to flag problems and recommend next steps. Maintain the product knowledge layer across Notion, documentation as code, and other internal sources of truth. Improve the workflows and automation that keep it current. Use agentic tooling and lightweight code to remove operational friction. Build scripts, ship small fixes, and support analysis without waiting for a dedicated Engineering cycle. Who you are You have 4+ years of experience in product operations, program management, business operations, consulting, technical program management, or a related role. You have run complex launches or programs across Product, Engineering, or go-to-market teams. You bring structure to unclear problems, make ownership explicit, and keep work moving when priorities change. You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical teams and can influence without formal authority. You are conversant in how software ships: you can work in a codebase, understand pull requests, and use agents to ship small fixes or analysis. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable working in code either directly or via agents. Experience with enterprise software, release management, support operations, or product analytics is helpful. Legal experience is not required. title: Staff Platform Engineer
description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Platform team Platform at hx builds the foundation that enables engineering teams to ship secure, scalable applications at velocity. We're evolving towards an AI-first platform where self-service infrastructure, intelligent automation, and reusable components compound developer productivity and operational excellence. This isn't about maintaining the status quo; we're reimagining how modern software delivery works. As the Staff Platform Engineer , you will own the technical direction of this evolution. You will define the architecture and engineering standards that others build to, drive coherence across teams, and ensure the platform strategy is aligned to long-term business outcomes. You will shape how AI-first, self-service infrastructure is done at scale, not just by delivering capabilities yourself, but by creating the conditions for engineering teams across the organisation to move faster, more safely, and more autonomously. Check out our Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining! What you'll be doing Establish a coherent 12–18 month technical direction for the platform, with clearly articulated trade-offs, milestones, and alignment across engineering leadership. The roadmap is understood, trusted, and actively referenced by stakeholders. Platform capabilities are adopted broadly across engineering, not because teams are told to use them, but because they are well-designed, well-documented, and genuinely reduce friction. Measurable reduction in Platform as a bottleneck for common provisioning and deployment tasks. Define the architectural patterns and standards that enable autonomous and AI-augmented workflows across the organisation. Other engineers can build AI-native capabilities without requiring Platform's direct involvement in every initiative. Platform defined standards for security, reliability, and operational excellence are embedded into how all teams build not enforced through gatekeeping, but adopted because they are the path of least resistance. Measurable reduction in misconfiguration, security exceptions, and operational incidents across the estate. Senior engineers are visibly stronger for having worked alongside you. The team develops better instincts for architecture, trade-offs, and platform thinking. You are sought out as a technical authority. What you'll need to have done Defined the architecture, standards, and patterns for the platform domain over a multi-quarter horizon. Makes high-judgement calls on foundational trade-offs such as build vs buy, depth vs breadth, short-term pragmatism vs long-term coherence and brings the organisation along on those decisions.aa Navigating disagreement across senior engineers, architects, and stakeholders to reach durable technical decisions. Comfortable holding a position under pressure, updating it when presented with better evidence, and ensuring decisions stick once made.a Accountability for outcomes that span multiple teams and that they do not personally deliver. Designs systems, standards, and enablement approaches that multiply the effectiveness of the engineers araound them, rather than being the primary hands-on contributor to every initiative. Defined how AI and automation are embedded into the platform at an architectural level not just experimenting with tools, but establishing patterns that make AI-augmented workflows the default for engineering teams across the organisation. Understanding of the adoption dynamics, internal customer needs, and the systemic barriers to self-service. Shapes the platform roadmap based on feedback, usage data, and a clear-eyed view of where friction exists and ensures the platform earns its adoption rather than mandating it. Identified architectural, security, and operational risks before they become incidents. Influences how the broader engineering organisation thinks about reliability, security posture, and cost efficiency not just within Platform's direct remit. Connecting platform decisions to business outcomes clearly and credibly. Can represent the platform strategy to senior leadership, translate engineering constraints into business language, and use commercial context to sharpen technical priorities.aa Actively developing senior engineers through technical challenge, honest feedback, and deliberate exposure to harder problems. Recognised as someone who raises the capability of the team, not just the quality of the code. Models the engineering culture the organisation is trying to build. title: Senior Staff Product Engineer
description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Engineering team At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology. Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users. How we work We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder , and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work. We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods , usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart. We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move. Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest. A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer. The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 5 , that looks like this. What you'll be doing Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion. Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced. Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve. Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting. Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you. Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating. What you'll need to have done Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered. Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve. Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps. Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to. Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce. Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity. Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them. At Level 5 we'll also look for Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team. Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on. Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated. You’re unlikely to thrive here if You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach. You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges. You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us. Compensation At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make. Benefits £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development. 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total). Company pension scheme via Penfold. Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life . Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno. Private healthcare insurance through AXA. Income protection and Life Insurance. Cycle to Work Scheme. Additional perks Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.). Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights. Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry. Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together. Interview process Initial chat with our Talent team Lead Hirer Interview Live AI Skills Assessment Values Interview with the CPTO Meet the CEO Our commitment to Diversity hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive. Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team. Next steps If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome. title: Paralegal / Legal Engineer
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . Summary We're looking for an early-career legal professional to help drive how Legal works at Dust. You'll shape and build legal processes and tools, and you'll get directly involved in a broad range of commercial legal matters, working under the supervision of Dust's lawyers. This role combines legal engineering and process improvement with hands-on experience in commercial contracting, including customer, vendor and partner matters. With a view to qualifying as a solicitor, the role may lead to consideration for an England & Wales training contract, subject to performance, business needs, eligibility and formal approval. A training contract is a potential pathway, not a guarantee. What you'll do Drive legal engineering and process improvement Identify recurring legal bottlenecks and design better ways for the company to get legal support. Translate legal rules and approved playbooks into practical workflows, templates, structured guidance and automations. Build and improve legal workflows using Dust and other appropriate tools, including intake, contract review and approval processes. Test workflows, gather feedback, document how they work and iterate to improve their quality and adoption. Build appropriate controls into processes, including lawyer review points, escalation paths and safeguards for confidential information. Get directly involved in commercial legal work Draft, review and prepare redlines for a wide range of commercial agreements, including NDAs, SaaS agreements, MSAs, order forms, DPAs, vendor contracts and partnership agreements. Support negotiation and deal execution with Sales, GTM and other teams, including participating in discussions when appropriate and under lawyer supervision. Help identify legal, privacy, data protection, security and AI-related issues in commercial matters, and bring them to the right lawyer for review. Conduct legal research, prepare issue summaries and help develop practical options for resolving contract questions. Progressively take on more responsibility as your experience and judgment develop, while escalating non-standard or higher-risk issues to qualified counsel. Build the legal team's capabilities Help create and improve templates, playbooks, legal knowledge resources and tools that allow the wider company to handle routine work more consistently. Use and improve systems that make matter status, contract obligations and key deadlines visible, rather than relying on manual follow-up. Work with the General Counsel, Commercial Counsel and external counsel across a varied commercial workload. Requirements Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same three dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude and Agency . Aptitude Legal training, such as a law degree, paralegal qualification or equivalent experience. Some experience in a paralegal, legal assistant, commercial contracts or legal operations role is helpful. We're also open to strong early-career candidates. Clear legal writing, research and issue-spotting skills, with an interest in commercial law. Interest or experience in process design, automation, no-code or low-code tools, AI workflows or contract-management systems. Business-standard English is required. Business-standard French is a strong advantage, but not essential. Willingness to travel to the US or Paris from time to time when required. Attitude Curious and motivated to develop as a commercial legal professional. Organised, careful and discreet when handling confidential information. A clear communicator who is comfortable asking questions, surfacing uncertainty and taking feedback. Collaborative and pragmatic, with a genuine interest in helping colleagues move work forward. Agency Proactively identifies opportunities to improve how legal work is done, then helps design and build the solution. Takes ownership of process improvements from problem definition through implementation, testing and iteration. Gets directly involved in commercial legal matters and follows them through within the level of responsibility agreed with supervising lawyers. Uses judgment to move work forward while escalating decisions that require qualified legal review. Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work. Our product constitution, a story about our mission Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human , Stanislas Polu , VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them. Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI , Gabriel Hubert , Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. title: Strategic Account Executive
description: 📍Manchester (Hybrid) | 💰 Basic £50k, realistic £100k OTE Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology. Join our Enterprise Sales team to drive new business growth across Spectre and Street.co.uk . With the support of our industry-leading, multi-award-winning prospecting and CRM technology, you’ll have the opportunity to drive new business, close high-value deals, and play a key role in shaping the future of PropTech in the UK. As we continue to scale, we’re looking for a Strategic Account Executive to spearhead enterprise-level sales, working closely with our VP of Sales to drive revenue growth. You’ll be responsible for prospecting, engaging, and closing high-value deals, selling to board-level stakeholders and securing strategic partnerships. This role requires a consultative sales approach, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to multi-thread across complex organisations to drive adoption of our full product suite. If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a rapidly growing company, we think you’d fit right in! A bit about you… You have 2+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record in enterprise sales. Enterprise sales strategy expertise, including account mapping, multi-threading, and engaging multiple stakeholders. Strong outbound prospecting skills, with experience in either Challenger, Gap Selling or PClub sales methodology, MEDDIC qualification methodology, forecasting, and ABM/ABS strategies. Exceptional negotiation and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decision-makers and close high-value deals. Consultative sales approach, able to understand business challenges and position tailored solutions. Resilience, confidence, and presence - you can hold the room, drive conversations, and articulate value effectively. A team player mindset, working collaboratively across departments to drive success. Coachability, always seeking to refine your approach and stay ahead in enterprise sales best practices. Here’s what you can expect to be working on as a Strategic Account Executive at Street Group Executing ABM/ABS strategies, identifying and targeting key accounts with a structured approach. Prospecting and outbound outreach, using cold calling, email, and LinkedIn to generate new business opportunities. Managing and optimising CRM data, ensuring accurate tracking of leads, interactions, and progress. Conducting research on industries, prospects, and competitors to craft personalised outreach. Handling objections with confidence, positioning value-driven solutions tailored to client needs. Collaborating with our Technical Pre-Sales team to map prospect workflows and demonstrate how Street transforms the way their agency operates end to end. Developing strong relationships with multiple stakeholders within a business to drive engagement. Becoming a product expert, understanding how our solutions solve industry challenges. Refining sales processes and methodologies, working closely with leadership to enhance effectiveness. Collaborating with sales, marketing, and a Strategic SDR to ensure seamless lead handoff, targeted outreach, and effective nurture strategies. Continuously improving performance, embracing feedback, and adapting to new strategies and insights. You probably shouldn't apply if: You've only ever done inside sales. This role is field-based, and roughly half your time is out with customers. You need a fully qualified pipeline handed to you. Prospecting and pipeline generation are core to the role. You're expecting a job where you can coast on existing relationships. We're hunting for new business into accounts we don't yet own. You're looking for a fully remote role. We need you in the Manchester office a minimum of three days per week, every other week, and out with customers the rest of the time. You think your product knowledge matters more than your ability to sell. We'll teach you the product; your commercial acumen is what we're hiring. Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria; please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application! Who are Street Group? We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone. Our products, Street.co.uk and Spectre form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent’s job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK. Back in 2015, our co-Founder, Tom Staff, spent his evenings building Spectre v1.0. He’d seen first-hand an opportunity to automate the very manual process of winning new business for estate agents. Spectre is now our multi award-winning, instruction generation tool, generating an average return on investment for them of over 3000%! Why join Street Group? 🏠 Hybrid-working 🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!) 💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth 📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development 🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away 🙋 ‘Give something back’ - 2 paid days volunteering on us 👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay 🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured 🧘 Regular well-being initiatives 🕒 Flexible working hours 🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition 👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! Candidate experience is really important to us, and our Talent team use AI notetakers on interviews so that they can focus purely on their conversation with you. All decisions are made by humans - not AI. Let us know if you have any questions! title: Senior Product Engineer
description: About Lendable Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start: One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK Profitable since 2017 Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot ) So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance . We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1 Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions Build the best technology in-house : we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting Operations is roughly half of Lendable's people. Central Ops Engineering is a small product engineering team that builds the tooling to help keep back office operations lean and efficient, while maintaining good customer outcomes. We're hiring a senior product engineer who can own and deliver large problems in that space. You'll build the internal web apps and automations that agents use every day, and help shape how the team uses AI coding tools. What you'll work on Current problems include: Complaints: we've already made handling much more efficient for officers, and are continuing to push on this. Fraud and Fincrime: putting the signals an investigator needs into one place. Quality assurance: using AI to review far more calls than a QA team can sample, and directing coaching to the agents who need it. How we work We use Claude Code, Codex, Augment and other AI tools every day. They've tripled our productivity, and we want you to help decide where we take that next. You'll hand real work to coding agents and take responsibility for what ships. You'll work directly with ops agents and their managers, and with Product. Data Science and Analytics own the models and prompt engineering, and you'll build the tools that put their work in front of agents. Who you are An experienced product engineer with a strong track record of delivering practical, full-stack solutions on modern technology Comfortable with ambiguity and focused on business outcomes, looking beyond the stated requirements to address the underlying problem Experienced in shaping team ways of working and mentoring other engineers Enthusiastic about AI-assisted development, ideally with a record of using it to improve how your team delivers Our tech stack This is what we use today, to give you a feel for the work. If your tech stack is different, we'd still like to hear from you: we've successfully onboarded engineers from different stacks in the past. title: QA Engineer
description: <p><em>We are the UK's leading premium publisher, home to iconic and influential media brands including Esquire, Men's & Women's Health, ELLE, Good Housekeeping, Harper's Bazaar, Digital Spy, Cosmopolitan, Red and more. At Hearst UK, we don't just create content – we shape culture.</em></p> <p><em>Our workplace is driven by passion, shaped by authenticity and powered by creativity. We back bold ideas, act with an entrepreneurial mindset and continually evolve to meet the moment – while respecting the legacy that's brought us here. We believe in each other's potential and push boundaries together to create meaningful impact, both across the media landscape and in people's lives.</em></p> <p><em>We're proud of our heritage – but even more excited about making history.</em></p> <p><em>Hearst UK operates an in-office policy with flexible Fridays. Our office is based at <strong>House of Hearst, 30 Panton Street, St James's, London, SW1Y 4AJ</strong>, where teams collaborate in person and connect across brands and functions.</em></p> <p><strong>Salary - Circa £55,000 - </strong>Salary is dependent on experience and will be assessed in line with the candidate's skills, knowledge and relevant expertise.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Role…</strong></p> <p>As our QA Engineer, you’ll play a key role in making sure Hearst’s websites and apps deliver a seamless, reliable experience for millions of users across the UK. Working closely with Product, Design, Engineering and Editorial teams, you’ll test new features, challenge how things work, uncover issues and help bring great digital experiences to life.</p> <p>You’ll work across our global platforms, making sure new developments are not only technically robust, but work brilliantly for our UK audiences. From new product launches to everyday improvements, you’ll help set the standard for quality at every stage of the journey.</p> <p><strong>Main Duties…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Plan and carry out testing for website and app features across different devices, browsers and operating systems.</li> <li>Check that changes meet agreed requirements and work well for people using our products.</li> <li>Report bugs clearly, including steps to reproduce them, and work with engineers to confirm fixes.</li> <li>Run regression tests to check that new releases have not affected existing features.</li> <li>Contribute to test plans and release checks throughout the development process.</li> <li>Work with engineering teams on optimising automated testing by identifying suitable test cases. </li> <li>Use AI enabled testing tools and workflows to help identify risks, improve test coverage and make quality checks more efficient.</li> <li>Raise usability, accessibility and performance concerns with the relevant teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Are Looking For…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience testing websites and mobile apps, with a clear understanding of functional and regression testing.</li> <li>Confidence using different devices, browsers and operating systems to identify and investigate issues.</li> <li>The ability to write clear bug reports and communicate findings to technical and non-technical colleagues.</li> <li>A methodical approach, good attention to detail and the judgement to prioritise issues by their impact on users.</li> <li>Familiarity with test management or bug tracking tools, such as Jira.</li> <li>Some experience with test automation tools or basic scripting; this is desirable.</li> <li>A collaborative mindset and interest in improving the quality and accessibility of digital products.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Benefits… </strong></p> <p>(Your benefits at Hearst UK are more than just extras—they are tools to help you thrive in every part of life. </p> <p><strong>Hearst Exclusives - Only for You! </strong></p> <ul> <li>Get adventurous with Good Housekeeping Taste and Beauty Testing Panels - yes, you could be trying the next big thing in beauty, food & drink. </li> <li>Snag luxe beauty steals at our legendary office sample sales - score big on top brands without breaking the bank!  </li> </ul> <p><strong>Inclusion, Health & Wellbeing: Feel Your Best </strong></p> <ul> <li>Stay healthy with Specsavers eye care, a company-funded Health Cash Plan, and access to mental health support. </li> <li>Get active and stress-free with discounted gym memberships and the Cycle to Work scheme. </li> <li>Embrace flexibility with a Location Flex and Holiday Exchange to take time when you need it. </li> <li>Take time to give back with a Charity Day and access wellbeing resources whenever you need them. </li> <li>Join one of our Hearst ERG Groups. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Wellness - Boost Your Budget </strong></p> <ul> <li>Plan ahead with a generous Workplace Pension, Income Protection, Life Assurance and Season Ticket Loan for easier commuting. </li> <li>Make smarter money moves using Salary Finance tools, Financial Wellbeing sessions, and Home Tech benefits to spread costs. </li> <li>Treat yourself with major discounts across London plus everyday savings via the HAPI at Hearst app </li> </ul> <p><strong>Hearst UK is deeply committed to using our influential brands to reflect the world we want to live in – one that respects, protects, represents and uplifts the voices and opinions of all people. As a business, we recognise the significant benefits of creativity, collaboration and innovation that comes with diverse teams. Not only is diversifying the voices in our organization the right thing to do, but it also helps us to make powerful and exciting content that can be enjoyed by many more people. This is why we’re working to build a sense of true belonging within our business and foster a culture in which everyone feels heard. </strong></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

You will build enduring relationships with senior stakeholders, drive commercial strategy, and oversee multidisciplinary delivery teams to ensure cutting-edge AI deployments are secure, reliable, and grounded in real-world impact. This is an opportunity to help build a distinctive practice inside a company with world-class technical depth and the ambition to set the standard for AI in the Retail sector. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations. If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. As Customer Operations Director, you will lead our customer service, order management and sales support teams across our international Building Automation markets. Your goal is to make sure customers and partners get fast, reliable and consistent service, from their first question to final delivery. This role is for a leader who sees the bigger picture and knows how to turn it into effective day-to-day operations. What will you do? You are responsible for the full customer journey after first contact. That covers answering customer questions and requests, processing orders, following up on quotes, and coordinating deliveries and service. You work closely with Sales, Technical Support, Supply Chain and Finance. You will: Lead and develop teams across multiple countries: set clear roles, coach team leaders, and manage capacity and service levels. Bring customer service, order management and sales support together into one way of working, with clear ownership and smooth handovers between teams and countries. Support Sales: handle incoming requests, follow up on quotes and orders, and keep customer data in the CRM accurate. Sales keeps ownership of accounts, pricing and targets. Set up a clear process for technical customer questions with our Technical Support team, from first response to escalation. Work with Supply Chain on product availability and delivery dates, and keep customers and Sales informed when issues come up. Simplify processes, reduce manual work, and standardize ways of working across countries while respecting local language and market needs. Work with IT to improve how teams use our CRM, order management system and customer portals. Use customer feedback and data to improve service, and share insights with Sales and Product. Lead the organization through change together with HR and country managers, while keeping service levels high. In addition: You have 10+ years of experience in customer service, order management and/or sales support in a B2B environment. You have 5+ years of leadership experience, including managing team leaders and being responsible for service performance. You have a proven track record of improving processes and leading change, ideally across multiple countries. You combine commercial awareness with operational discipline. You have experience with CRM and order management systems, and you know how to turn data into practical improvements. Experience in building automation, technical products or subscription services is a strong plus. You are fluent in Dutch and professionally proficient in English. German is a plus. You are willing to travel regularly between teams and markets. What you get In numbers A competitive salary based on your experience; We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 8% holiday allowance; Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. For your own sustainability Be secured with our pension plan; Feel engaged and join our participation plan; Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football. Ready to make an impact? Do you want to take Customer Operations within Building Automation to the next level and build a strong, scalable and customer-focused organization for our customers and partners? Then we would love to meet you. Apply for the position of Customer Operations Director and discover how you can make an impact at Priva. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Platform Engineer
description: About us We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents. We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day. Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing. Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things. Want to join our pack? Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets. A day in the life As a Platform Engineer, you will initially join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on. This role has a strong security focus, and it will become more security focused over time. Much of the work is compliance and assurance: building and running the tooling that checks our cloud estate against our security standards, writing the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one, gathering the evidence we need for ISO 27001 and our other obligations, and supporting the audits that depend on it. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services. Over time this role moves across to work directly with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security function at ManyPets. You will help shape what that function does and how it works, rather than inheriting something already built. Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration. We embrace modern development practices: · All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience. · We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day. · We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start. As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement. Your responsibilities ü Build and maintain secure platform foundations o Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on. o Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable. o Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it. o Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services. o Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads. Make our security posture measurable o Automate the gathering of evidence for ISO 27001 and our other compliance obligations, so that an audit means pulling a report rather than running a manual exercise. o Write the scripts and small services that turn a manual security check into a scheduled, repeatable one. o Triage findings from our scanning and posture tooling such as Aikido and Ascidian, work out which ones actually matter, and either fix them or get them in front of the team that can. o Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling. Strengthen access and identity controls o Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege. o Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities. o Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review. Extend our platform standards beyond AWS o Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate. o Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are. Team collaboration o Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions. o Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously. o Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews. o Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance. Self development o Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan. o Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset. o Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship. Your skills and experience We are looking for someone with: · Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure). · Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code. · Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines. · A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals. · Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python. · Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously. You will also need at least one current associate-level cloud certification: · AWS: Solutions Architect Associate, Developer Associate or SysOps Administrator Associate. We would also be interested in the AWS Certified Security Speciality. · Google Cloud: Associate Cloud Engineer. · Microsoft Azure: Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500). Entry-level certifications such as AWS Cloud Practitioner, Google Cloud Digital Leader and Azure Fundamentals do not meet this on their own. Please include the certification name and your credential ID or badge link with your application. We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other: · A security specialism, where you can tell us about security or compliance tooling you have built and what it caught. · Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud. The interview process This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom. · Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team. · Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need. · Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise. · Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security. About the team The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about. Our tech stack We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn. You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas. Our "north star" is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics. To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean. We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding. We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices. We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud. Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | MongoDB | Aikido | Ascidian | Cloudflare Salary range: £55,000 — £65,000 GBP Ways of working On a typical day you'll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset. You'll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we'd expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day. We'd ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively. We'll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support. Inclusion at ManyPets We promise to give you the same opportunities as everyone else and we won't discriminate against you at any point in the process. This includes how we source talent, our interview process, our conditions of employment (including pay) and feedback. If you'd like to read more about this, please download our Approach to Inclusion policy.
