title: Principal Compliance Associate - Market Surveillance
description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets, and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them. We're hiring a Principal Compliance Associate to take on the function's most complex casework, and help shape how we detect and cover market abuse as the business scales. The opportunity Own complex investigations end to end, writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on, and present conclusions to a range of stakeholders. Lead or contribute to periodic threshold and model reviews, recalibrating surveillance rules and alert thresholds as trading behaviour, products and market structure evolve. Support the design, build-out and integration of surveillance platform capability, including onboarding new products, venues and data sources onto the surveillance system. Contribute to market abuse risk assessments, helping identify and score risk across products, jurisdictions and entities, and translate findings into surveillance coverage. Use AI and automation tools responsibly to speed up evidence-gathering, case reconstruction and detection-model development, always with human judgement over the final call. Support conflicts of interest, information barrier, and personal account dealing matters across Markets Compliance, extending beyond surveillance casework where buy-side or asset management experience is directly relevant. What you bring Experience investigating market abuse or trading conduct inside a firm subject to market conduct regulation, such as an exchange, broker-dealer, trading venue, or comparable regulated trading business. A track record running investigations end to end, including writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on and presenting conclusions to stakeholders. Working knowledge of core market abuse typologies e.g. spoofing, wash trading, insider trading, front running, ramping. Experience with, or strong working knowledge of, threshold and model calibration, surveillance platform integration, market abuse risk assessments, and audit remediation. Comfort using generative AI and other automation tools to improve the speed and quality of investigative work, while maintaining the human oversight regulated casework requires. Familiarity with a surveillance platform (such as Scila, Nasdaq SMARTS, Eventus, or NICE Actimize) and comfort with SQL or a similar query tool for evidence-gathering. Clear, evidence-first written communication - your case files, escalations and regulatory drafts will sometimes be read by auditors and regulators without you in the room to explain them. Exposure to crypto-asset markets is welcomed but not required. What matters most is regulated-market investigation experience; strong candidates from traditional securities or derivatives markets are encouraged to apply. Nice to haves E-comms surveillance experience. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Our commitment Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. title: Product Engineer
description: About Adclear At Adclear, we’re building the trust layer for how the world’s most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We’re turning the function that has always said “no” into infrastructure that says “yes, and here’s how.” This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we’re only at the beginning. The product you’ll help build is what people actually touch when they experience that shift. Founded in 2024, we’ve already earned the trust of leading innovators and established enterprises including Monzo, NatWest, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others. Our early traction let us raise £2.6m in funding, and we’re now scaling fast. We’re building the product engine that turns a genuinely novel category into something people love to use, and this is where you come in. The Role This is a full-stack product engineering role for someone who has shipped real features and wants to take on more ownership. You’ll work alongside senior engineers and the founders on product slices from spec to production. Over time you’ll own them end-to-end. Here’s the kind of work you’ll contribute to: A Chrome extension that runs compliance checks inline in Google Docs, where marketers actually write copy. It was built with Monzo as the design partner and is public on the Chrome Web Store. A natural-language copilot for compliance work. Users ask in plain English, the platform proposes typed actions, a human approves, and the action runs. The interface where reviewers watch the model reason through a decision, step in when they disagree, and feed structured corrections back into the rules. Integrations that reach into wherever customers create marketing: Canva, Figma, Google Docs, Contentful, Workfront, Monday.com , and Frame.io for video. A dashboard that takes a long, unsorted list of compliance tasks and turns it into a single prioritised queue. Our users are compliance and marketing teams at leading fintechs. They use Adclear every day and tell us quickly when something’s wrong. That tight feedback loop is one of the best things about the job, and it’s a fast way to grow. What you’ll do Ship product features from spec to production. Most of the work is across the full stack, and integration work where needed. You’ll start with guidance and take on bigger slices as you grow. Build the surfaces compliance reviewers live in: workflows, review UIs, and the moments where model output meets human judgement. Work on features where AI is in the critical path. The model is genuinely part of the product, not bolted on. Ship a change to production on your first day and a feature in your first few weeks. We deploy continuously, so you’ll feel the pace immediately. Bring your perspective to what we build and how we build it. We want to hear when something doesn’t make sense. Learn from senior engineers through code review, pairing and design discussions, and help raise the bar yourself. What we’re looking for Proven delivery. Building production web applications, with features you’ve shipped that real users depend on. Growing ownership. You can take a well-scoped feature and run with it. You know when to ask for input and when to unblock yourself. You want to grow towards owning larger, more ambiguous pieces of work. Product sense. You care about the user experience, notice when something feels off, and aren’t afraid to say so. You’re learning to balance polish against shipping at pace. Collaboration. You communicate clearly with engineers, designers and founders, ask good questions when something is underspecified, and are receptive to feedback. AI literacy. You use modern coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, agents) day to day. You treat them as collaborators, check their output critically, and are curious about where they help and where they get in the way. Technical skills Solid TypeScript and React, with working experience on the backend. Experience with, or a strong interest in, building products where AI is in the critical path. Familiarity with modern web tooling, including Node and Postgres. Nice to have Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Hono or Drizzle. Exposure to regulated industries such as fintech, healthtech or legaltech. The Stack React, TypeScript and Tailwind on the frontend. A Hono API on Cloudflare Workers. Drizzle and Postgres on the data layer. title: Property & Facilities Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Deadline for applications is November 20th.</strong></p> <p>📍 London | 💰 Salary £60,000 - £65,000 + Incentive Awards - <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> |<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4"> Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <h2><strong>⭐ Our People team</strong></h2> <p>We call it Monzo Magic. Mission. Action. Growth. Inclusion. Care.</p> <p>It's at the heart of everything we do. Within our People Collective, we're here to bring brilliant people together, build an inclusive culture and create an environment where everyone can do their best work. As Monzo continues to grow, our offices play an important role in bringing our people together. They're more than just places to work. They're spaces where teams connect, collaborate and experience what it means to be a Monzonaut.</p> <p>We're looking for an experienced <strong>Property & Facilities Lead</strong> to join us on a 12 month fixed term contract, covering caregiver leave. You'll lead a team of six across four office locations in London, Cardiff, Dublin and Barcelona, helping us deliver an exceptional workplace experience while managing and developing our global property portfolio.</p> <p>Reporting to the Head of Property, Culture and Engagement, you'll oversee our daily operations, lead strategic projects and collaborate with teams across Monzo to create safe, welcoming and engaging workplaces that bring people together and put the Monzonaut community first.</p> <h2><strong>🔑 You'll play a key role by...</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>🏢 Leading our global property and facilities operations</strong> – Overseeing our office locations, ensuring they're safe and compliant, while delivering a consistent and delightful workplace experience.</li> <li><strong>🚀 Managing and delivering property projects</strong> – Leading projects from planning to delivery, including office moves, refurbishments and new site launches. You'll manage timelines, budgets and internal and external stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes.</li> <li><strong>🌍 Supporting our global property strategy</strong> – Turning our longer term property ambitions into practical plans, ensuring our spaces meet the needs of our people and support Monzo's continued growth.</li> <li><strong>💪 Leading and developing a brilliant team</strong> – Managing six team members across all locations, setting clear priorities, supporting their development and building a scalable, high-performing function.</li> <li><strong>🤝 Collaborating across Monzo</strong> – Building strong relationships with Finance, Legal, TechOps and senior leadership to align priorities, influence decisions and deliver improvements.</li> <li><strong>💰 Managing budgets and suppliers</strong> – Overseeing property and facilities budgets, managing supplier relationships and ensuring we're delivering value for money across our portfolio.</li> <li><strong>🦺 Keeping our spaces safe and sustainable</strong> – Ensuring our workplaces meet health and safety requirements, managing compliance and working with the ESG team to deliver our Scope 1 and 2 environmental commitments.</li> <li><strong>✨ Continuously improving how we work</strong> – Using data and employee feedback to improve our spaces, streamline processes and build scalable ways of working. You'll also be happy to roll up your sleeves and provide hands on support when needed.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>🤩 We'd love to hear from you if...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have strong <strong>property and facilities management experience</strong>, ideally in a fast-paced, growing organisation with multiple office locations.</li> <li>You're an <strong>experienced project manager</strong>, confident leading complex projects end to end, managing timelines, budgets, risks and competing priorities.</li> <li>You're a <strong>confident people leader</strong>, with experience managing, coaching and developing high performing teams.</li> <li>You're <strong>commercially minded</strong>, with experience managing budgets, suppliers and contracts while balancing cost, quality and employee experience.</li> <li>You're a <strong>strong communicator and collaborator</strong>, comfortable working with senior stakeholders and building relationships across teams.</li> <li>You're <strong>proactive, organised and adaptable</strong>, able to balance day-to-day operations with strategic priorities, navigate ambiguity and make decisions independently.</li> <li>You're <strong>data-driven</strong>, and can use insights to make decisions and improve processes.</li> <li>You have a good understanding of <strong>workplace health and safety</strong>, and are confident using digital tools such as Google Workspace and Slack</li> <li>[Nice to have] You have a formal health and safety, facilities and/or project  management qualification such as IWFM 7, NVQ, NEBOSH, PRINCE 2 or APM.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! </strong>We know that some people are less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every requirement. At Monzo, we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we care just as much about your potential as your experience. If you're excited about this opportunity and think you could make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.</p> <h2><strong>🙌 What's in it for you</strong></h2> <p>💰 £60k - £65k + Incentive Awards</p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office, with a minimum of three days per week in the office. You'll also travel periodically to our Cardiff, Dublin and Barcelona offices.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to manage your time in a way that works for you, your team and the role.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 annual learning budget to spend on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We'll provide you with a MacBook and the equipment you need to work effectively.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <h2><strong>🌈 The application journey</strong></h2> <p>Our hiring process is designed to help us get to know you, your experience and how you approach real-world challenges.</p> <p>There are four stages:</p> <ol> <li><strong>Initial call</strong> – An initial conversation to learn more about you and share more about the opportunity.</li> <li><strong>Role-specific interview</strong> – A deeper conversation about your technical experience, project management and approach to leading a multi-site function.</li> <li><strong>Manager and leadership interview</strong> – An opportunity to explore your leadership style, stakeholder management and how you approach decision-making.</li> </ol> <p>We aim to complete the process in around 2–3 weeks and will be as flexible as possible to accommodate your schedule.</p> <p>We also have some guidance on using AI during your application and interview.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read it here.</a></p> <p>#LI-OH #LI-LONDON</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. title: Sales Manager - Buy Side
description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent . We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites , with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far. We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy. The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards , came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100 . Learn more about us on our website . 🎙️ The Role We're hiring a Buy Side Originator to join the Commercial team in our Buy engine. tem lets businesses buy renewable energy directly from the generators that produce it - transparent pricing, fair terms, no middlemen. Demand from smaller businesses is growing fast, and we need someone to own it. You will run a high-velocity sales motion end-to-end: qualify, progress, close, and hand off cleanly. You'll work directly with business customers buying energy through tem, backed by a CRM and AI-assisted outreach tooling that keeps your pipeline full while you focus on the conversations that close deals. In your first 12 months, you might: Close your first SMB deals within your opening weeks, working a live pipeline from day one. Own the long tail of a fast-growing SMB pipeline, keeping deals moving instead of going stale. Put signed volume on the board that counts directly towards the Buy engine's goals. Sharpen our SMB playbook with front-line feedback on what buyers ask and where deals stick. Grow towards owning bigger slices of the origination motion. 🚀 Responsibilities Close with pace: own smaller direct SMB opportunities from first contact to signature, keeping momentum with clear next steps. Qualify fast: run discovery calls to understand each customer's site, contract timing and usage, and triage leads into chase, nurture or drop. Sell honestly: explain the tem proposition clearly, handle the objections SMBs actually raise, and walk away when a deal isn't right for the customer. Keep it clean: maintain tight CRM hygiene - notes, stages and timelines always current - so nothing slips and handoffs into onboarding are smooth. Work smart: use AI and outreach tooling to cover more pipeline than a traditional rep could, without losing judgement on the calls that matter. Feed the loop: share what customers are asking for and where deals get stuck, so the proposition keeps improving. 🎯 Requirements Must-Haves Experience in direct B2B sales where you owned deals end-to-end, qualify to close. Comfortable speaking with customers every day and working a high-volume pipeline without letting deals go stale. Strong discovery and objection-handling instincts - you can explain a cost-savings proposition to a non-technical buyer. Disciplined CRM habits: clear notes, accurate stages, honest reporting. Low ego, direct and coachable - honest with customers even when it costs the deal. Desirable Experience selling into SMBs in energy, utilities or another price-sensitive market. Familiarity with sales automation and AI-assisted outreach tooling. Experience running renewal or retention motions alongside new business. ✨ Benefits & Perks Competitive salary Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission. 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off. Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons. Up to £1,200 or €1,200 per year for your remote setup. Up to £150 or €150 per month for wellbeing. 🗣️ Interview Process First call with our Talent Team. Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager (30 mins). Technical Interview with the Team (45 - 60 mins). You'll meet with potential peers in this session and will discuss how you run a high-velocity sales motion - discovery, qualification, objection handling and closing - including a practical exercise. Bar Raiser Interview with a leader in the business. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for. title: Front End Design Engineer
description: About Seamflow Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files. Where we are: Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze. Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists. The team Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further. The role A Front End Design Engineer thinks in finished interfaces, not mockups or components in isolation. A technical reviewer at a notified body spends their day inside a 400-page technical file, cross-referencing clauses, checking test reports against standards, and deciding whether a medical device is safe to sell. Today they do that in Word, Acrobat and a spreadsheet someone built in 2011. The interface they use decides how fast they work and whether they trust the AI sitting next to them. You own that interface. Layout, typography, interaction, motion, the design system underneath it, and the React that ships it. You decide how a reviewer sees a finding, how they correct a model that got it wrong, and how a hundred fields of dense regulatory data become something a person can actually read. You sketch it, build it, ship it, then sit next to someone using it and find out what you got wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week. What we're looking for We care far more about taste and engineering strength than about matching a list of tools. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in React, Svelte, Vue or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, craft and speed are not. What we're actually screening for: You've designed and built an interface that real people used every day. Not a Dribbble shot, not a component library nobody adopted. Something that shipped, got used, and got better. You have taste, and you can defend it. Typography, spacing, motion, hierarchy. You notice when something is a few pixels off and you can explain why it matters. You build the whole thing. Design, frontend, the state and data it sits on. You don't hand the code to someone else once the Figma is done, and you don't hand the design to someone else once the code is. You can design for density. Expert users, complex workflows, hundreds of fields on a screen. Making that clear is much harder than making a landing page beautiful. You go to the source. You'll watch a technical reviewer work through a real file, and you'll design for what they actually do rather than what the process diagram says. Signals we like, none of them required: design engineering or front-end roles at somewhere like Linear, Vercel, Notion or Figma, a design system you built and maintained, work on interfaces where people review or correct AI output, founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup. This is probably not for you if You want a strict boundary between work and life. We run one of the most ambitious startup cultures in Europe: fast paced, extremely high ownership, and in person in Shoreditch. You want a well-defined ticket handed to you each morning. You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane. What you get Real equity, and compensation that reflects a high bar Genuine ownership of product surface area from day one, with the founders in the room Relocation support and visa sponsorship, handled properly Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access, and any tool that makes you faster A small team with high standards, high trust, and no politics If this sounds like your kind of problem, apply. A short note on the hardest thing you've built goes further with us than a polished CV. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Backend Engineer - Partner Flow
description: Backend Engineer - Partner Flow Team Hybrid in London / Remote within the UK We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join the Partner Flow team. This role is a chance to shape how thousands of small businesses find their way to iwoca. You'll join the team that owns iwoca's partner integrations — the Lending API and embedded flows that let third-party platforms, from major banks to fintechs, offer iwoca loans inside their own customer journeys. You'll own projects, collaborate with stakeholders, and design robust systems to deliver important functionality and measurably improve the experience for our partners and customers. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team iwoca partners with a variety of third-party platforms, ranging from large banks and comparison sites to small fintechs that serve SME customers. These partners use iwoca’s Lending API to embed iwoca loans into their own customer journey. Partnerships are an important and fast-growing source of customers for iwoca. The Partner Flow team builds new features and optimises existing flows to provide the best possible experience for iwoca's partners and the customers they refer to us. The team’s responsibilities include: Continually improving our Lending API and other developer tools, so that partners can integrate with iwoca quickly and easily. Adding new functionality to facilitate deeper integrations and ensure iwoca is the best embedded finance provider on the market. Improving the conversion rate of customers who come to us through partners - streamlining the journey, running RCTs (randomised control trials) and building models alongside our embedded data scientist to find what works. The team is made up of three engineers, a data scientist plus a team lead, working closely with an internal team of commercial stakeholders. This role is one of two new engineering hires as we grow the team to meet our ambition. Partner Flow is remote/hybrid-friendly, meeting up for team days in the office once or twice a month, but not on a fixed schedule. They work in an Agile fashion with two-week sprints and a daily standup. The role You’ll work on challenging projects all over iwoca’s codebase - anywhere there are improvements to be made for partners and partner-referred customers. You’ll be encouraged to bring your own ideas and take responsibility for areas of functionality. Autonomy: Own features and projects from scoping and design through to production. Collaborate with other engineers to meet the team’s goals, whilst being trusted to define your own solutions and work independently on your part of the problem. Design and maintain robust, flexible, and maintainable systems to ensure scalability and fast-paced development. Impact: Deliver new functionality critical to onboarding important new partners. Run experiments (RCTs) and optimise the funnel to measurably improve how partner-referred customers convert. Leave code, docs, and processes in better shape than you found them. Purpose and product thinking: Work on systems that genuinely help businesses get the funding they need. Collaborate with our partners and internal stakeholders to design effective solutions. Use data to make decisions, uncover insights, and refine strategies. AI: We're pushing hard on AI-assisted development. Engineers here write clear technical specs, let skills and agents implement boiler-plate, and hold a high bar on code review — the person, not the model, is accountable for what merges. We expect AI output to be validated for correctness, performance and security like any other change. We give the team unlimited tokens across all models and expect people to experiment. The requirements Essential: Experience designing and building scalable back-end systems, ideally in Python. Experience working with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, with an understanding of performance and maintainability considerations. Experience building and maintaining APIs that are easy to use, reliable, and well-documented. Experience managing projects end to end, from understanding business problems to designing and delivering technical solutions. Pragmatism in balancing delivery speed with long-term system health. Clear, concise written and verbal communication, focusing on outcomes and impact. A genuine team player: you support your teammates, share knowledge, and care about the team's success as much as your own. AI fluency. Experience using AI coding tools to accelerate real delivery, and a genuine interest in getting better at it - with a pragmatic sense of where it adds value and where it doesn't. Bonus: Front-end development experience, particularly with React and Typescript. Experience with DevOps practices, including containerisation and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with experimentation (e.g. A/B tests or RCTs) or using data to drive product decisions. Working knowledge of modern data tooling - ideally Snowflake and dbt - used to build analytical or reporting pipelines. The salary We expect to pay from £60,000—£85,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. An employee equity incentive scheme. Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money. Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme. Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone. Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers. Access to learning platforms like Treehouse. title: Senior Match-3 Designer, New Game
description: We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match-3 Designer (internally Game Designer) to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game. You’ll own the overall match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define how the puzzle game feels to play while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar. You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience. As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game. What You'll Be Doing Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels. Collaborate with developers to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience. Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes. Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision. Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps. Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets Treefrog’s standards. Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving. What You Have Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games. Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes. Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle. Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows. Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers. Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends. Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences. A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge. What We're Looking for A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously. A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals. A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems. Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency. The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards. A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar. Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions. A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals. A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture. Where You'll Be This role is based in our London office. title: System Test Automation Engineer
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Verification and Release Test Team Wayve’s Verification and Release Test team sits at the intersection of hardware, embedded software and machine learning models. Our testing spans component, system and vehicle levels, and we build novel test automation in-house to identify issues earlier in development. We pride ourselves on finding the most efficient and effective ways to deliver the most valuable results for the company. As a System Test Engineer, HIL, you’ll build robust, reusable automation and work across engineering disciplines to improve coverage, reliability and traceability. This is a hands-on delivery role with room to grow into broader areas of the system, including sensing and model-behaviour testing, as Wayve and your experience evolve. 🧠 Your day-to-day Develop automation for system functionality tests at component, integration and system levels, working across software and hardware boundaries. Lead root-cause investigations for failures identified during test campaigns, collaborating with hardware, software, infrastructure and DevOps teams to resolve issues. Analyse test results, uncover software and hardware bugs, and report findings through Jira with clear evidence to support debugging. Optimise Buildkite CI/CD-integrated test workflows for rapid, reliable and repeatable execution. Review, create and follow risk assessments to ensure all testing activities are conducted safely and responsibly. 🧩 What you’ll be working on: Independently owning the design and delivery of automated verification for a defined area of our embedded software stack, steadily raising the bar on coverage, reliability and traceability. Building open-loop and closed-loop hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) replay tests, alongside reliability and fault-injection tests, to support verification, release and debugging. Automating HIL test setups and improving test infrastructure to expand coverage, make failures easier to trace and strengthen compliance reporting. Integrating requirements, coverage and compliance workflows, including Jama, MC/DC coverage analysis and MISRA checks, and managing test artefacts through Artifactory and Azure. Developing traceability dashboards and defining KPIs and quality metrics that support data-driven validation and release decisions. 🙌 You should apply if: You have hands-on experience with system-level verification and validation in robotics, embedded software or mechatronic systems, with a track record of independently delivering test automation. You’re highly proficient in Python and have experience developing automation test frameworks using pytest. You’ve worked with HIL testing and tooling, including interfaces such as CAN, Ethernet or GMSL, and tools from dSPACE, Vector, Xylon or similar providers. You understand open-loop and closed-loop HIL replay testing using dSPACE or other emulators. You’re familiar with automotive safety and process standards, including ISO 26262, ASPICE and SOTIF, and have experience integrating requirements and test-management tools such as Jama and Xray. You’re proficient in CI/CD principles and related tooling, such as GitLab CI, Buildkite and Bazel. You have experience developing or testing automotive software at embedded and system levels, including hardware/software interactions and interface-level testing, and have worked with L2+ hands-off, L3 or L4 automated driving systems. You have knowledge of consumer safety-rating protocols such as Euro NCAP, including AEB and LSS/LKA scenarios; DCAS regulatory testing under UN R171; and automotive cybersecurity testing and standards, including ISO/SAE 21434 and UN R155. You’ve worked with test automation dashboards, logging and reporting infrastructure, using tools such as Grafana, Looker, Datadog and Jira. You’re a self-starter with a sharp eye for improvement who communicates clearly and works effectively across software, hardware, autonomy, DevOps and product teams. Ideally, you’ve contributed to improvements in test methods, safety procedures or operational efficiency, and are familiar with data management and version control tools such as Git. Experience using agentic AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude Code to accelerate and improve test development, debugging and automation workflows would also be valuable. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes) Competency Interviews (Programming and hiring manager interview; 1 hour 45 minutes total) Deep-dive technical interviews (Cross-functional, system design; 1 hour 45 minutes total) Final interview : mission & values alignment (45 minutes). We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory. Impact</strong></p> <p>As one of our Directors in the Solutions Development team you will be focused specifically on leading the design and development for enhanced digital performance within WPP Media Solutions in ways that have client appeal and are revenue returning.</p> <p>With either extensive performance marketing, or in-platform performance experience in social and programmatic, you will canvas the broad responsibility of leading strategically on designing the destination and mapping the requirements, with tactical development planning to ensure we build, test, and launch with robust processes.</p> <p>Strategically, you will act as a forward-looking leader and innovation agent, shaping the future of performance within WPP Media Solutions and directly influencing our own path to delivering Guaranteed Outcomes to clients.</p> <p>Tactically, you will both lead cross-functional working groups to build, test and launch while also collaborating with marketing science, directly feeding into the rest of the portfolio – defining, evolving and championing lower funnel performance delivery for clients in line with our gold standard measurement and effectiveness framework.</p> <p>The role promises to offer you a platform for individual growth, matrix management of cross-functional teams across Data & Tech, Solutions Integrations, Marketing Science, Planning, and Activation with a platform for true client and business impact.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Overall Purpose:</strong></p> <p>To lead, shape, and directly influence our lower funnel performance offer to clients – grounded in social and OR programmatic, with influence into the wider portfolio.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Responsibility set</strong></p> <ul> clients with a lens on Social and Programmatic Display, understanding competitive landscapes, and collaboratively shaping solution differentiation. Lead channel innovation leveraging our Desirability, Feasibility, Viability framework.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional leadership:</strong>Lead cross-functional working groups, bringing together diverse teams (media, tech, marketing science, planning, activation) to deliver prioritized developments and planned benefits. This involves being a project manager for complex initiatives.</li> <li><strong>Senior stakeholder engagement:</strong>Engage confidently with senior leaders and stakeholders to drive ideas, influence strategy, and articulate the value of proposed solutions.</li> <li><strong>Channel ecosystem understanding:</strong>Network with agency practitioners and EMEA colleagues to ensure a finely tuned understanding of how channels are planned, activated, and measured, driving solution consistency and identifying opportunities for share and reapply.</li> <li><strong>Commercial & compliance oversight:</strong>Ensure the compliant design and development of owned channel solutions, continuously reviewing pricing, margin setting, and market fit. Maintain a deep understanding of the supply chain and cost model.</li> <li><strong>Roadmap & delivery:</strong>Develop and deliver a channel roadmap, manage solution materials, and troubleshoot business challenges to ensure an enhanced and integrated portfolio of solutions.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years with performance marketing experience in Media, with proof points in Performance, Social and OR Programmatic trading.</li> <li>Evidenced experience and understanding of Digital Media, both from a media and technical perspective with strong relationships with adtech/martech partners to enable solution development</li> <li>Performance Marketing craft knowledge and industry POV is important.</li> <li>An entrepreneurial attitude with a portfolio of experiences to showcase ability to recognise and develop new client solutions ahead of market maturity</li> <li>Accredited or can speak to project management experience to effectively manage cross-functional teams and associated developments</li> <li>Confidence and Ability to manage and deliver multiple projects to multiple deadlines simultaneously</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> <strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. description: About Legend At Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company. Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. The Role: We're looking for an experienced Senior Financial Reporting Manager to join our Finance team on a fixed-term basis, providing essential leadership and continuity while we navigate an exciting period of integration and change. This is a hands-on role for a technically strong, commercially aware finance professional who thrives in a fast-paced, complex international environment. You'll take ownership of our month-end reporting cycle, ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of financial information across a multi-jurisdictional group. You'll also be a trusted point of contact for the wider Finance team, providing guidance, resolving challenges and keeping business-as-usual operations running smoothly. We're looking for someone who can quickly get up to speed, confidently make decisions and bring structure and clarity to a busy reporting environment. Your Impact: Lead the end-to-end month-end close and financial reporting process across a complex, multi-entity, multi-jurisdictional group, ensuring accurate and timely delivery of consolidated trial balances and reporting outputs. Own the month-end timetable, prioritising critical activities, resolving reporting challenges and coordinating stakeholders to meet demanding deadlines. Provide oversight of balance sheet reporting, reconciliations and financial controls, ensuring accuracy, consistency and compliance with group accounting policies. Act as the primary point of contact for the Financial Reporting team, providing hands-on leadership, guidance and confident decision-making to maintain smooth day-to-day operations. Partner with Finance teams and stakeholders across the business, supporting external audit requirements and resolving complex financial reporting matters. Identify practical opportunities to improve reporting processes, strengthen controls and leverage data and automation to drive greater efficiency. What You’ll Bring: A recognised accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent), with substantial relevant accounting experience, ideally including 7+ years post-qualification. Strong financial reporting experience within a large multinational organisation, with exposure to complex group structures, multiple entities and jurisdictions. Proven ownership of an end-to-end month-end close, including group consolidations, consolidated trial balances and delivery against tight deadlines. Strong technical accounting knowledge, particularly across balance sheet reporting, reconciliations, financial controls and group reporting. Confident leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to guide teams, build relationships quickly and make sound decisions independently. Excellent analytical skills, strong data literacy and advanced Excel capabilities, with experience working across complex financial systems and datasets. A proactive, adaptable approach, with the ability to quickly understand a new environment, take initiative and deliver results with minimal onboarding. Why Legend? Super smart colleagues to work alongside and learn from. Engaging development opportunities at all levels. Tailored flexibility for your work-life balance. Annual discretionary bonus to reward your efforts. Paid annual leave PLUS a well-deserved break to recharge your batteries during the festive season! Our offices are closed between Christmas and New Year's, allowing you to enjoy downtime without dipping into your annual allowance. Exciting global Legend events, where we unite in person to ignite our shared passion and unveil the exciting strategies for the year ahead! Unlock your full potential by joining the Legend team. To support you on this journey, we provide an extensive array of global benefits, alongside local perks. Legend is an Equal Opportunity Employer, but that’s just the start. We believe different perspectives help us grow and achieve more. That’s why we’re dedicated to hiring and developing the most talented and diverse team- which includes individuals with different backgrounds, abilities, identities and experiences. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout your application process, please speak to your Talent Partner or contact the team ----- and we'll do all we can to support you. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Allow us to introduce ourselves</strong></p> <p>Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.</p> <p>We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over <strong>260 employees</strong> spread across <strong>13 countries </strong>(we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from <strong data-stringify-type="bold">+190 markets,</strong> globally.</p> <p>Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? <strong>🚀</strong></p> <p><span data-preserver-spaces="true">Here at Appinio, we value <strong>transparency</strong> <strong>in our recruitment process</strong>, and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together:</span><strong><span data-preserver-spaces="true"><em data-stringify-type="italic"> </em></span><span data-preserver-spaces="true"><a class="c-link c-link--focus-visible" href="https://www.appinio.com/en/blog/life-at-appinio/appinio-recruitment-process" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.appinio.com/en/blog/life-at-appinio/appinio-recruitment-process" data-sk="tooltip_parent">here</a></span></strong></p></div><p><strong>Your mission as a (Senior) Research Consultant</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a <strong>(Senior)</strong><strong> Research Consultant (m/f/d) </strong>with a strong quantitative market research background to join our newly dedicated B2B research team in the DACH region.</p> <p>This specialized unit focuses on research projects that specifically survey B2B target groups, professional decision-makers, and niche business audiences (rather than only standard B2C consumer panels). You will work closely with leading global strategy and management consultancies as well as major international corporates, supporting high-stakes projects where research needs to be delivered quickly, precisely, and with a clear focus on the business question.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p> <ul> <li>End-to-End B2B Project Lead: Manage quantitative research projects end-to-end, including B2B screening design, questionnaire drafting, platform setup, fieldwork monitoring, and data delivery.</li> <li>Methodology & Study Design: Optimise bespoke study designs across core use cases (e.g., Target Group Analysis, U&A, Pricing studies, Concept Testing) mainly tailored to hard-to-reach professional audiences.</li> <li>Senior Client Sparring & Advisory: Act as a trusted research partner to leading global consulting firms and major corporate clients. Work directly with experienced consultants and senior stakeholders to translate business questions into robust research approaches, advise on sample feasibility and survey methodology, and make pragmatic decisions when timelines are tight.</li> <li>Commercial & Scoping Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales and Account Management on project scoping, feasibility checks, and methodology definition for complex project requests.</li> <li>Process & Quality Enhancement: Contribute to standardizing B2B screening protocols, sampling frameworks, and best practices to coach other researcher and safeguard delivery speed and research quality across the team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You will thrive in this role if</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 5+ years of experience in quantitative market title: Sr. Technical Account Manager (TAM)
description: Onwards Together! Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters. Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running. Location: UK Remote or Netherlands Remote Our Team's Vision: Technical Account Managers Technical Account Managers exist to help customers sustain and expand the technical value of their Illumio investment. We serve as strategic technical advisors to our customers, ensuring that Illumio’s segmentation platform is fully adopted, optimized, and operationalized to deliver sustained, measurable business value. Through proactive engagement, deep technical expertise, and continuous alignment to customer priorities and operating models, we drive measurable outcomes by accelerating adoption, advancing platform maturity, and enabling customers to realize the full operational value of their investment—reducing risk and operating with confidence at scale. Technical Account Managers work in close partnership with Customer Success Advisors, Professional Services, Support, Sales, and Engineering to deliver a seamless customer experience. By identifying risks early, guiding technical decision-making, and advancing platform maturity, TAMs ensure customers not only achieve their initial objectives but are positioned to advance technical maturity, optimize adoption, and maximize the operational value of the platform. Joining the Technical Account Manager team means becoming part of a highly collaborative organization focused on technical excellence, customer advocacy, and outcome-driven engagement. If you’re passionate about solving complex technical challenges, providing strategic technical guidance, and helping customers maximize the impact of their cybersecurity investments, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact. Your Impact: Serve as strategic technical advisors to customer stakeholders by understanding their security objectives, customer priorities, operating model, risk profile, platform maturity, and business priorities. Deliver structured TAM engagements that help customers fully adopt, optimize, and operationalize Illumio’s segmentation platform through onboarding support, adoption planning, operational reviews, value realization activities, and renewal or expansion readiness. Translate platform telemetry, adoption signals, support trends, and customer feedback into actionable guidance that advances platform maturity, improves operational confidence, and delivers sustained, measurable business value. Provide proactive strategic advisory by guiding technical decision-making for upgrades, architecture changes, policy evolution, feature adoption, and other critical decisions that support customer priorities and operating models. Accelerate adoption and value realization by identifying adoption gaps, recommending enablement opportunities, supporting platform utilization reviews, and helping customers maximize the operational value of their Illumio investment. Assess operational and environmental health through health reviews, support case analysis, incident pattern recognition, risk identification, and best-practice recommendations that help reduce risk and improve confidence at scale. Strengthen customer resilience by identifying risks early, coordinating escalation management, documenting remediation actions, and helping customers reduce repeat operational friction. Prepare and deliver executive-ready insights such as QBR content, impact reviews, adoption summaries, value realization updates, health assessments, and risk mitigation recommendations that demonstrate sustained technical and business value. Partner closely with Customer Success Advisors, Professional Services, Support, Sales, Engineering, Product Management, and account teams to deliver a seamless customer experience and coordinated outcomes. Travel up to 30% for customer engagements, executive reviews, team meetings, training, and field enablement, based on business need. Your Toolkit: Working knowledge of cybersecurity, Zero Trust, segmentation, enterprise infrastructure, security operations, or related environments that support customer adoption, optimization, and operationalization. Demonstrated experience translating technical data, adoption metrics, platform signals, support trends, or customer feedback into practical recommendations that advance platform maturity and measurable outcomes. Ability to communicate clearly with technical teams, executives, project owners, and cross-functional partners, including the ability to translate complex technical topics into business-relevant guidance tied to customer priorities. Experience supporting customer-facing technical engagements such as adoption reviews, health checks, operational reviews, escalation management, implementation advisory, enablement sessions, or executive business reviews that help customers sustain and expand technical value. Ability to learn new technologies, understand customer operating models, and guide customers through technical change with proactive planning, risk awareness, and follow-through. Business acumen, consultative problem-solving skills, and the ability to connect technical recommendations to adoption, risk reduction, operational confidence, renewal confidence, expansion opportunities, and measurable business value. Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively across Customer Success Advisors, Professional Services, Support, Sales, Engineering, Product Management, account teams, and field enablement teams. Experience supporting enterprise software, SaaS platforms, cybersecurity solutions, infrastructure technologies, professional services, customer success, implementation, technical support, or other complex technical customer environments. Relevant experience may come from full-time, part-time, consulting, contract, military, government, startup, enterprise, customer success, professional services, technical support, implementation, or other nontraditional career paths. Comfort working within a defined delivery framework that uses standardized deliverables, platform maturity indicators, engagement cadence, and success measures to drive consistent, outcome-driven engagement. Bonus Points: Applied technical experience in engineering, science, computer science, cybersecurity, or related fields; formal education is welcome but not required when equivalent practical experience demonstrates the needed capability. Knowledge of networking concepts such as routers, switches, load balancers, segmentation, firewalls, policy models, telemetry, logging, and enterprise security solutions. Exposure to heterogeneous security environments—such as monitoring, alerting, SIEM, SOAR, ticketing, or operational workflow tools, is a plus, especially when paired with the ability to connect those tools to customer outcomes. Familiarity with customer lifecycle motions such as onboarding, adoption, optimization, operationalization, expansion, renewal, QBRs, value realization reviews, health reviews, or executive stakeholder engagement. Organizational skills with the ability to prioritize work across multiple customer engagements, track risks and actions, and communicate status, outcomes, measurable value, and next steps clearly. Technical certifications are welcome but not required; applied experience and demonstrated ability to learn are valued. #LI-SC1 #LI-REMOTE Our Commitment Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success. All official job offers from our company are extended directly by our recruitment team and will be sent through an official E-Signature document for your review and signature. Please be aware that we do not ask for any personal information in the process of extending offers of employment, such as financial details or social security numbers. Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience. title: AI Platform Engineer
description: About us People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry. Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality. Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies. How we work Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents. Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate. At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work. End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it. In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication. Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly. Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues. The role We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it. You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built. Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are. Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on. AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products. Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear. What we look for A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction. Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it. High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through. Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so. Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore. Why join You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Founding Product
description: About us People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. In reality, hundred of thousands of operators acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on, with tools that have barely changed in decades and spending hours a day on email. Nexcade is building the agentic operating system for those people, transforming the way people communicate and optimise the $1T spend on logistics every year. Our agents are live in production with leading global Freight Forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are rapidly expanding the platform to touch every part of the logistics lifecycle. Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality from top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies. How we work Everybody builds, founders included. The whole company is technical and runs on coding agents. You will not be asked to write production software, but you will use agents for discovery synthesis, specs, prototypes and data analysis rather than doing them by hand. Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate. At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work. End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it. In person, in London. We value synchronous communication. Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly. Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues. The role We’re building the AI platform freight forwarders rely on. We started with quoting and are expanding across the shipment lifecycle. As Product Lead, you will be central to that expansion, helping decide where we focus and turning those decisions into products customers depend on. What you’ll do: Own product outcomes: Own the roadmap, priorities and performance of specific products, from defining the customer problem through launch, rollout and adoption. Partner with the founders on overall product direction and strategy. Build from customer insight: Work closely with freight forwarders across commercial and operational roles. Understand how they work, identify the problems customers share and build products for those needs rather than one-off solutions. Prototype and build: Turn ideas into working prototypes and early product versions, using AI tools and code to test them with customers. Work hands-on with engineering to take promising ideas into production, not just write specs and hand them over. Drive product expansion: Build a clear view of the market, including where we win, where we do not compete and why customers choose us. Use that understanding to identify the next workflows Nexcade should enter and turn them into products that grow revenue. Raise the standard of product thinking: Define success measures, test assumptions and examine accuracy, edge cases and second-order effects before scaling. Write clear specs and decision documents, including a written recommendation on the hard calls. Build the product operating system: Establish a clear planning and decision-making cadence without adding bureaucracy. Make sure product meetings are well prepared, teams have the context they need and decisions translate into shipped work. Make product and platform trade-offs: Work closely with engineering to decide when to invest in shared capabilities and when a faster, product-specific approach is right. What we look for Strong product judgement: You have owned meaningful product work in a complex B2B product and can show how your decisions changed customer behaviour or business results. You define success clearly and test assumptions, accuracy and edge cases before scaling. Product taste: You can turn complex workflows into products that feel simple, coherent and trustworthy. You care about the details that make people choose to use them. Technical fluency: You work effectively with strong engineers, understand trade-offs across architecture, AI, data and integrations and bring the customer and product perspective to choices about speed, quality and reuse. Excellent judgement: You get beyond what customers ask for to understand how their work really happens and distinguish repeatable needs from bespoke requests. You use customer and market insight to make product choices that drive adoption, expansion and revenue. High agency and directness: You take ownership, hold a high bar and disagree openly and constructively. You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration and changing priorities. Obsess over the problem: You are drawn to complex, messy problems in industries the economy depends on and want to understand how the people and systems behind them really work. Industry experience is a bonus, but not required. Why join The biggest product choices are still ahead: how deep we go, where we expand and how everything fits together. Our product is already live with leading freight forwarders and this role will shape what comes next. You will build AI for the work that keeps global trade moving, alongside a team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will get meaningful equity in the company you help build. About the role Reporting to Sarah Phillips, you’ll own month-end for Flock’s finance team and strengthen the controls around it, running the close and producing the variance analysis and MI that FP&A and our senior team use for budgeting and reporting. We’re automating finance on our new platform and the team uses AI every day, so there’s plenty of room to improve how the work gets done as well as doing it.
